The [MON] radiates an aura in a [#] ft radius, lasting [DURATION], that draws all fluids out through a creature's mouth, nose, eyes, ears, and pores. Every creature of the [MON]'s choosing that starts its turn in the affected area must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

The [MON] plays a song that bolsters its allies. Each ally within [#] ft of the [MON] that can hear it gains a +[#] bonus to attack rolls ability checks and saves until the song ends. The [MON] must use a bonus action on subsequent turns to continue playing the song. The song ends if the [MON] is incapacitated. A creature can benefit from only one Courageous Anthem at a time.

Intelligent creatures within [#] ft of the [MON] who are able to hear its voice must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. Those who fail find the sound of the [MON]'s voice pleasant and alluring, so that the [MON] has advantage on Charisma checks against them [DURATION]. The affected characters can't attack the [MON] during this time unless they are wounded in that time.

The [MON] projects an illusory duplicate of itself that appears in its space. When a creature targets the [MON] with an attack, if the attack roll would hit the [MON] and isn't a critical hit, the attack hits the duplicate instead, destroying it. A creature is unaffected by this ability if it can't see, if it relies on senses other than sight, or if it can see through illusions.

If the [MON] burrows at least [#] ft straight toward a target, it can burst out of the ground. Each creature in its space when it erupts must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage, be pushed out of the [MON]'s space, and be knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed but not knocked prone.

The [MON] commands its mount to move up to [#] ft in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement, the mount swims in a corkscrew around the creatures in the line. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be incapacitated with dizziness [DURATION]. The mount must have a swimming speed to use this maneuver.

While underwater the [MON] exudes a cloud of inky slime in a [#] ft radius sphere. Each non-[MON] creature in that area when the cloud appears must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be poisoned [DURATION]. The slime extends around corners and the area is heavily obscured [DURATION] or until a strong current dissipates the cloud.

The [MON] removes oxygen from nearby water [DURATION]. Each creature that requires oxygen to live (including air-breathing creatures under effects of water breathing) and starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or begin suffocating. The [MON] never suffers effects of this; can choose any creatures in that area to ignore it.

The [MON] blows on its brass horn, calling forth 10 (3d4 + 3) warrior spirits. These spirits appear within [#] ft of the [MON] and use tribal warrior statistics. When the spirits are summoned, one of them is always an ancient champion that uses berserker statistics. They disappear after [DURATION] or when they are reduced to 0 hit points. These spirits follow the [MON]'s commands.

The target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage, can't breathe, speak, or cast spells, and begins suffocating. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and is no longer grappled. Until this strangling grapple ends (escape DC [SAVE_DC]), the target takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of each of its turns.

The [MON] moves up to [#] ft in a straight line and can move through objects as if they were difficult terrain. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. If it moves through a object, the object takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage. If it moves through a ship, the ship's pilot can make a DC [SAVE_DC] Wisdom check using navigator's tools, halving the damage on a success.

The [MON] creates a magical illusion of an unmoving object in a space it can see within [#] ft of it. The illusion can hide a smaller object in the same space. The illusion lasts [DURATION] until a creature touches it or [DURATION]. A creature can use an action to attempt a DC [SAVE_DC] Intelligence (Investigation) check. On a success, the illusion appears transparent to the creature.

The [MON] creates prison of chains around an up to Medium creature grappled by it. Imprisoned: restrained and takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. Imprisoned creature or creature within [#] ft of the [MON] can use action to free imprisoned creature. Doing so requires DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check and creature attempting takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

The [MON] throws its head up to [#] ft. Each creature within [#] ft of the head must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. After using this action the [MON] no longer has a head. It can still use its senses but can no longer use Fire Breath. It can create a new head when it finishes a long rest.

Gusts of sleet emanate from the [MON] in a [#] ft radius sphere [DURATION], spreading around corners. The area is lightly obscured and the ground is difficult terrain. The first time a creature other than the [MON] moves on its turn while in that area, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone (or fall if it is flying).

The [MON] draws the moisture from a [#] ft radius area centered on itself. Nonmagical water and other liquids in this area turn to dust. Each living creature in that area must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. Liquids carried by a creature that succeeds on this saving throw are not destroyed.

The [MON] rears up and lands heavily, kicking up a shower of debris and rattling and cracking the ground. Each creature in contact with the ground within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage only. The area then becomes difficult terrain.

The [MON] grows in size. This works like the enlarge/reduce spell, except the [MON] can only enlarge and it lasts [DURATION]. While enlarged, the [MON] gains the following action: Swallow. The [MON] makes one bite attack against a target it is grappling. On a hit, the target is also consumed, and the grapple ends. The creature is automatically expelled when the [MON] is no longer enlarged.

One target caught in the [MON]'s vortex is thrown up to [#] ft in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage for every [#] ft it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take the same damage, and be knocked prone.

The [MON] targets one creature within [#] ft of one of its rootlet swarms. The target takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and is grappled (escape DC [SAVE_DC]), or takes half as much damage and isn't grappled if it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Dexterity saving throw. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, it has disadvantage on Strength checks and [ABILITY] saving throws.

While merged with a humanoid (see Aural Symbiosis), the [MON] feeds on nearby creatures. Up to nine creatures of the [MON]'s choice within [#] ft of it can be targeted. Each target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and have its hit point max reduced by the same amount [DURATION]. Victims notice this damage immediately, but not its source.

The [MON] creates an icy blizzard in that area around it. A [#] ft radius sphere surrounding the [MON] fills with icy fog, whirling snow, and driving ice crystals. Vision is lightly obscured, and creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on vision or hearing. The ground in the affected area becomes difficult terrain. The effect lasts [DURATION] and moves with the [MON].

The [MON] decreases in size by one category [DURATION], along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While shrunken, the [MON] halves its damage dice on Strength-based attacks, and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with disadvantage. At the end of that duration, if the [MON] lacks the room to grow back to its regular size, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

The [MON] attempts to absorb the spirit of a dead or undead creature in its belly. The creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be absorbed by the [MON]. A creature absorbed this way is destroyed and can't be reanimated, though it can be restored to life by powerful magic, such as a resurrection spell. The [MON] regains hit points equal to the absorbed creature's hit point max.

The [MON] chooses up to two points it can see within [#] ft of it. The [MON] can't choose a point within [#] ft of it. Each creature within [#] ft of a point must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. If a creature is within [#] ft of both points, it has disadvantage on this saving throw, but takes damage only once.

The [MON] is afraid of fire, and it won't move toward any fiery or burning objects. If presented forcefully with a flame, or if it is dealt fire damage, the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be frightened [DURATION]. After it has been frightened by a specific source of fire (such as the burning hands spell), the [MON] can't be frightened by that same source again [DURATION].

The [MON] consumes the corpse of one Medium or smaller humanoid or beast within [#] ft of it and transforms into it. statistics other than size are the same in new form. Any items worn/carried meld into new form. Can't activate use wield or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment. It reverts to its true aberrant form if it dies makes a Manipulate the Flesh attack or uses Assume Form while transformed.

The [MON] increases the power of its inner fire, causing metal weapons and armor to burn red-hot. Each creature within [#] ft of it that is in physical contact with a manufactured metal object takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or drop the object if it can. If it doesn't drop the object, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks [DURATION].

Two [MON]s within [#] ft of each other can combine their actions to move up to their speed with a 5 ft, two-person saw held between them and attack a single creature in their path. The target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone. If the target is knocked prone, each [MON] may make a melee attack against it as a bonus action.

The [MON] targets a corpse it can see within [#] ft of it that has been dead for no longer than [DURATION]. A stream of dark energy flows between the corpse and the [MON]. At the end of the [MON]'s next turn, the [MON] absorbs the corpse and it vanishes completely. Any worn items or possessions are unaffected. A corpse destroyed in this manner can't be retrieved other than by a wish spell or similar magic.

Plants erupt from the ground in a [#] ft radius around a point up to [#] ft from the [MON]. Each creature of the [MON]'s choice in that area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained [DURATION]. A creature can use its action to make a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check freeing itself or a creature within [#] ft of it on a success. Additionally the area is difficult terrain [DURATION].

The [MON]'s mandibles drip a searing acid, instantly igniting the gas around it. Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. The [MON]'s Nauseous Gas trait becomes inactive [DURATION]. The [MON] can't use Searing Gas unless Nauseous Gas has been active for at least [DURATION].

The [MON] throws a creature it is grappling at a space it can see within [#] ft of it. The thrown creature takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or land prone. If the target space is occupied by another creature that creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and be knocked prone.

The [MON] teleports up to [#] ft into a box, chest, wardrobe, or other wooden container with a lid or door. The [MON] can hide inside the container as a bonus action after teleporting. If the [MON] uses this action while inside a container, it can teleport into another container within range or it can teleport back to its home plane. If it does so, it can't return to the Material Plane until it is summoned.

The [MON]'s poison-imbued wrappings and flesh create toxic fumes when burned. If a [MON] takes [DMG_TYPE] damage, it is surrounded by a cloud of toxic smoke in a [#] ft radius. This cloud persists [DURATION]. A creature that starts its turn inside the cloud or enters it for the first time on its turn takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, or half as much damage with a successful DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw.

The [MON] drains the magic from an item it is holding. A magic item with charges loses 1d6 charges, an item with limited uses per day loses one daily use, and a single-use item such as a potion or spell scroll is destroyed. All other magic items have their effects suppressed [DURATION]. The [MON] gains 5 temporary hit points each time it drains a magic item. A drained item regains its magic after [DURATION].

The [MON] consumes one unattended metal object or attempts to consume a metal object worn or held by the creature it is grappling. The grappled creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or the object is consumed. If the object is a magic item, the creature has advantage on the saving throw. Magic items consumed by the [MON] stay intact in its stomach [DURATION] before they are destroyed.

The creatures appear in empty spaces of the [MON]'s choice on a demiplane. The demiplane can be up to one square mile in size. The demiplane can appear to be inside, outside, or underground, and can contain terrain, nonmagical objects, and magical effects of the [MON]'s choosing. The [MON] may populate it with creatures and hazards with a total Challenge Rating equal to or less than the [MON]'s Challenge Rating.

If the [MON] is underwater, it flares the light from its organs, making the skull-like structure within more apparent. If the [MON] is above water, it tightly pulls in its outer flesh, causing its body to take on a fleshy, skull-like appearance. Each humanoid within [#] ft of the [MON] that can see it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be frightened [DURATION].

action.ability_tags: Difficult Terrain, Prone Effect, Zero Speed
action.desc: Areas of unworked earth within [#] ft of it become swampy mud [DURATION]. These areas become difficult terrain. Prone creatures in that area when the mud appears or that are knocked prone in that area make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. On a failure, the creatures speed drops to 0 as it becomes stuck in the mud. A creature can use its action to make a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check, freeing itself on a success.

The [MON] causes orb at the end of its lure to glow. Can extinguish light as a bonus action. While light is active when a creature enters a space within [#] ft of the [MON] for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there and can see the light must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be charmed by the [MON] until light is extinguished. A creature can also re-save at the end of each of its turns.

The [MON] targets a single creature within [#] ft of it that broke the terms of a pact witnessed by the [MON]. The creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be blinded, deafened, and stunned [DURATION]. The conditions can be ended early only with a dispel magic (DC [SAVE_DC]) spell or similar magic. When these conditions end, the affected creature has disadvantage on saving throws [DURATION].

One inanimate, unattended chain within [#] ft of it sprouts blades and animates under the [MON]'s control [DURATION]. It has AC [#] and [#] hit points, a speed of 0, and immunity to psychic, piercing, poison, and thunder damage. When the [MON] uses Multiattack, the [MON] may command the chain to make one Chain attack against a target within [#] ft of it. If the chain is reduced to 0 hit points, it can't be reanimated.

The [MON] enters the corpse of a Small, Medium, or Large creature that has been dead less than [DURATION], impersonating it [DURATION] before the body decays. If the [MON] takes [#] damage or more on a single turn while inhabiting a body, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be ejected from the body, which then falls apart and is destroyed. Its stats other than its size are the same in each body.

The [MON] creates a skeleton out of a pile of bones or a the corpse of a creature within [#] ft of it. The skeleton is under the control of the [MON], obeying the [MON]'s mental commands, and uses the statistics of a CR 1 or lower skeleton of your choice. The [MON] can control up to three skeletons at one time. If the [MON] creates a skeleton while it already has three under its control, the oldest skeleton crumbles to dust.

If the [MON] burrows at least [#] ft straight toward a target, it can dig a [#] ft diameter, [#] ft deep pit beneath it. Each creature in the pit is area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or fall into the mycelium-lined pit and land prone, taking [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus falling damage. The [MON] can then make one Mycelium Spike attack against a prone creature in the pit as a bonus action.

The [MON] shoots a ray at a target it can see within [#] ft of it. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be moved up to [#] ft in any direction by the [MON]. If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is moved up to [#] ft in any direction. The [MON] can use this ability to manipulate simple tools or open doors and containers.

The [MON] forces a creature it is grappling to move up to the creature's speed and make one attack with a melee weapon the creature is holding. If the creature isn't holding a melee weapon, it makes one unarmed strike instead. The [MON] decides the direction of the movement and the target of the attack. The grappled creature can use its reaction and isn't considered blinded or restrained when moving and attacking in this way.

The [MON] creates an avalanche on a hill or mountainside centered on a point within [#] ft of it. Stones cascade down sloped or sheer stone surfaces within [#] ft of that point. Each non-[MON] creature within the affected area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage, is knocked prone, and moves with the avalanche until it reaches a flat surface or the edge of the area.
The [MON] increases its walking speed to [#] ft [DURATION] and moves in a straight line toward a target it can see.

The [MON] tucks in its head and throws itself, spikes first, into nearby foes. The [MON] moves up to [#] ft in a straight line and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this movement, the creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone.

The [MON] enters the nose and mouth of an incapacitated humanoid within [#] ft of it. The target must be Small or larger, have a brain and have an Intelligence of 4 or higher. The [MON] eats the target's brain and takes control of the target. The [MON] leaves the body if the target is reduced to 0 hit points, if the target is affected by dispel evil and good or another effect that ends possession, or voluntarily as a bonus action.

The [MON] changes its size between Large, Medium, and Tiny. While Tiny, the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by its attacks is halved and it has disadvantage on Strength checks and advantage on Dexterity checks. While Large, the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by its attacks is doubled and it has advantage on Strength checks and disadvantage on Dexterity checks. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

While on the Ethereal Plane the [MON] touches a sleeping humanoid that is not protected by a magic circle or protection from evil and good spell or similar magic. While the touch persists the [MON] appears in the creatures dreams. The creature can end the dream at any time. If the dream lasts [DURATION] the target gains no benefit from the rest and the [MON] can use Charm on the creature even if its on a different plane of existence.

The [MON] places a powerful explosive in a space within [#] ft of it, which detonates at the end of the [MON]'s next turn or when a creature moves to a space within [#] ft of the explosive, whichever happens first. Each creature within [#] ft of that point must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be pushed up to [#] ft away from the point and knocked prone.

The [MON] moves up to [#] ft in a straight line, moving through the space of any creature in its path. Each ally within [#] ft of the [MON] can use its reaction to move up to [#] ft in a straight line in the same direction, also moving through the space of any creature in its path. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Each time a stampeding creature enters a creature's space during this movement, that creature [OUTCOME].

The target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or the target's fate is bound to one random ally of the target. Any damage or condition the target suffers is inflicted on the individual to which they are bound instead, and vice versa. A creature can be bound to only one other creature at a time. This effect lasts until either of the affected creatures gains a level, or until a heal or heroes' feast lifts this binding.

While in contact with body of water it absorbs water that is a cube up to [#] ft on a side and becomes saturated as water fills its body. While saturated increases in size along with anything it is wearing or carrying becoming Huge and has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. If it lacks room to become Huge it attains max size possible in space available. Ground exposed by the absorbed water becomes difficult terrain.

The [MON] becomes super-heated, expelling momentous energy outwards in a [#] ft radius blast around it. Each creature caught in the blast must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the fire and force damage but isn't knocked prone. After using Flare, the [MON] is starving. It can't use Flare if it is starving.

A creature grappling the [MON] can take its action to remove the [MON]'s focus by succeeding on a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check. If its focus is removed or destroyed, the [MON] must make a DC [SAVE_DC] Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a success, the [MON] continues working properly, but it can repeat this saving throw the next round at 1 higher DC. On a failure, the [MON] dies, falling into a heap of armaments.

The [MON] selects a spot within [#] ft of itself; that spot glows with a faint, blue light [DURATION]. All other creatures that can see the light at the start of their turn must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be charmed [DURATION]. A creature charmed this way must Dash toward the light by the most direct route, automatically fails saving throws against being restrained by snare lines, and treats the [MON] as invisible.

The [MON] releases an absorbed spell effect as a blast of green energy, which blasts out as a sphere centered on the [MON] with a radius of [#] ft per level of the absorbed spell. All creatures in the area of effect other than the [MON] takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage per level of the absorbed spell, or half as much damage with a successful DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. Creatures that fail the saving throw are also blinded [DURATION].

The [MON] reads the surface thoughts of one creature within [#] ft of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 ft of wood or dirt, 2 ft of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the [MON] can continue reading its thoughts [DURATION]. While reading the target's mind, the [MON] has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

The [MON] conjures a giant ladle full of boiling water, which pours its contents on a point it can see within [#] ft of it. Each creature within [#] ft of that point must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be scalded [DURATION]. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage only. A scalded creature has disadvantage on weapon attack rolls and on [ABILITY] saving throws to maintain concentration.

action.ability_name: Tale of the Bar Room Rush
action.desc: The [MON] begins telling a story, which lasts up to [DURATION] if the [MON] uses a bonus action to continue telling it on subsequent turns. When the story begins, each [MON] within [#] ft of the [MON] that can hear it can use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Additionally, while the story is being told, each [MON] within [#] ft of the [MON] that can hear it can Dash or Disengage as a bonus action on its turn.

The [MON] violently returns to its true form. Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage (or [#dX] if the [MON] has extended its reach to [#] ft) and be deafened [DURATION]. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage only. A deafened target can make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

The [MON] chooses one nonmagical weapon it can see within [#] ft of it and warps it. If weapon is being worn or carried creature doing so can prevent warping via DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. Warped weapon deals only half its normal damage on a hit and creature wielding warped weapon has disadvantage on attack rolls with it. A creature can repair a warped weapon with mending spell or by spending a short rest repairing it with the appropriate tools.

The [MON] commands its mount to move up to [#] ft in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement, the mount flies up and over one creature in the line, ending its movement at least [#] ft past the target. As the [MON] hangs upside down at the top of the loop, it makes one melee attack against the target with advantage. On a hit, the [MON] rolls damage dice three times. The mount must have a flying speed to use this maneuver.

The [MON] summons or dismiss a ghostly mount mounting or dismounting it as part of this bonus action without spending movement. Mount uses the stats of a warhorse skeleton except it has the Incorporeal Movement trait a flying speed of [#] ft [#] hit points and resistance to cold and necrotic and B/P/S damage from nonmagical attacks. If mount is slain it disappears leaving behind no physical form and the [MON] must wait [DURATION] before summoning it again.

The [MON] compels all plants and roots within [#] ft of a point on the ground it can see within [#] ft of it to grasp and pull at nearby creatures [DURATION]. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained by grasses and roots. A creature including the restrained creature can use an action to free it by making a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check.

The [MON] places one target it is grappling into its extradimensional space if there is room and grapple ends. The target blinded and restrained and has total cover against attacks and effects outside. A trapped creature can take its action to climb out of the bag by succeeding on a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength or Dexterity check (creature's choice). If crab dies trapped creature is no longer restrained by crab and can escape bag using 5 ft of movement exiting prone.

The [MON] creates a snare in a square area it can see within [#] ft of it that is [#] ft on a side and at least 50% grass. 1st creature to moves into that space within next min must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained by grasses. A creature including restrained creature can use action to free restrained creature via DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check. It can have at most 3 snares set at a time. If it sets a 4th oldest ceases to function.

The [MON] transforms into an arc of lightning and flies up to [#] ft without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement the [MON] can pass through other creatures' spaces. Whenever it moves through another creatures space for the first time during this movement that creature must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. The [MON] then reverts to its original form.

The [MON] sends shock of lightning through its supercharged pseudopod at onecreature it can see within [#] ft of it ending supercharged state. The target: [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage (DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] half). Three bolts of lightning then leap to as many as three targets each must be within [#] ft of first target. The target can be creature or object and each can be targeted by only one bolt. Each target: [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage (DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] half).

The [MON] feeds on the body moisture of creatures it lures into kissing it. A creature must be charmed, grappled, or incapacitated to be kissed. A kiss hits automatically, does [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and fills the [MON] with an exultant rush of euphoria that has the same effect as a heroism spell lasting [DURATION]. The creature that was kissed doesn't notice that it took damage from the kiss unless it makes a successful DC [SAVE_DC] Wisdom (Perception) check.

The [MON] has a portal to the Void at its core. A creature that starts its turn grappled by the [MON] must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. On a success, the creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage but isn't pulled toward the portal. On a failure, the creature takes no damage but is pulled closer to the portal. A creature that fails three saving throws before escaping the grapple enters the portal and is affected as if targeted by the banishment spell.

The [MON] moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter creatures' spaces. Whenever the [MON] enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed [#] ft back or to the side of the [MON]. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the [MON] enters the creature's space and the creature is consumed.

The [MON] turns into a [#] ft radius roiling cloud of dust and sand filled with frightening shapes. A creature that starts its turn inside the cloud must choose whether to close its eyes and be blinded [DURATION], or keep its eyes open and make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the creature [OUTCOME]. A frightened creature repeats the [ABILITY] saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

The [MON] tosses a ball of fire at a creature it can see within [#] ft of it. The target must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. The ball then splits and bounces toward up to 4 creatures within [#] ft of the original target. Each new target must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

The [MON] uses an action to alter its appearance into a more frightening fungus, such as a poisonous deathcap mushroom, or back into its true form. Alternatively, it can change back into its true form as a reaction when it takes damage. Its statistics are the same in each form, and While in its frightening form, The [MON] can take only the Dodge, Disengage, and Hide actions. Any creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of a [MON] in its frightening form [OUTCOME].

The [MON] becomes a bolt of living lightning and moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and is pushed to the closest unoccupied space if it ends its turn inside an object. Each creature in the [MON]'s path must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

action.ability_tags: Bonus Action Attack, Movement, Restraining, Toppling
action.desc: If the [MON] moves at least [#] ft straight toward a target, it can dig a 5 ft diameter, [#] ft deep pit beneath the creature, and the target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or fall into the pit and land prone, taking falling damage as normal. If the target is Large or larger, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained. If the target is prone or restrained, the [MON] can make one attack against it as a bonus action.

The [MON] rapidly beats its wings, igniting them [DURATION]. It sheds bright light in [#] ft radius and dim light for an additional [#] ft. A creature that touches the [MON] or hits it with melee attack while within [#] ft of it takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. Additionally, when a creature starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON], it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. This effect ends early if the [MON] stops flying.

The [MON] wraps up a creature restrained by webbing. The wrapped target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw at the start of each of the [MON]'s turns or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage. The webbing can be attacked and destroyed (AC [#]; [#] hit points; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). The [MON] can have only one creature wrapped at a time.

If the [MON] is at least [#] ft off the ground, it can fall to the ground, landing on its feet and taking no damage. Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] when it lands must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed [#] ft away from the [MON]. If a creature is within [#] ft of the [MON] when it lands, it takes twice as much damage.

The [MON] touches a creature restrained by its webbing and transports itself and the creature into the Shadow Realm or the Material Plane, the [MON]'s choice. The [MON] and the target appear within [#] ft of each other in unoccupied spaces in the chosen plane. The destination location must be within [#] ft of the [MON]'s anchored web. If the target is unwilling, it can make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. On a success, the [MON] is transported but the target isn't.

The [MON] jumps up to [#] ft horizontally without provoking opportunity attacks and falls prone in a space containing one or more creatures. Each creature in its space must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and is pushed out of the [MON]'s space. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead is knocked prone in the [MON]'s space.

The [MON] teleports up to [#] ft to an unoccupied space it can see. When it does, it briefly transforms into a bolt of lightning, flashes upwards, then crashes down unharmed at its destination. Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON]'s starting location or destination must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. A creature within [#] ft of both locations makes this saving throw only once.

The [MON] moves up to its speed. While doing so it can enter creatures' spaces. Whenever the [MON] enters a creature's space the creature must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. If the creature is unaware of the [MON]'s presence it makes its saving throw against Engulf with disadvantage. On a success, the creature may use its reaction if available to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the creature doesn't move it is engulfed by the [MON].

The [MON] takes the form of a whirlwind, flies up to half of its fly speed without provoking opportunity attacks, and then resumes its normal form. When a creature shares its space with the whirlwind for the first time during this movement, that creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be carried inside the [MON]'s space until the whirlwind ends, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage for every [#] ft it was carried, and be knocked prone at the end of the movement.

The [MON] teleports to an unoccupied location within [#] ft of it, leaving a shimmering outline of its wings in its former location. The shimmering wings flap violently before exploding in a rainbow-colored dust cloud covering a [#] ft radius. Any creature caught in the dust cloud must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points. Creatures reduced to 0 hit points from this effect regenerate 10 hit points at the beginning of their next three turns.

The [MON] describes a creature so vividly, it takes on a semblance of reality. The [MON] creates an illusory creature that resembles a beast, monstrosity, or plant with CR 1 or less. The illusory creature moves and acts according to the [MON]'s mental direction and takes its turn immediately after the [MON]. It uses the statistics of the creature it resembles, except it can't use any abilities that force the target to make a saving throw. It remains [DURATION] or until it is killed.

The [MON] squats atop the target, pinning it to the ground, where it is grappled and restrained (escape DC [SAVE_DC]). The [MON] is free to attack another target, but the restrained creatures are released if it moves from its current space. As long as the [MON] does not move from the spot, it can maintain the squatting pin on up to two Medium-sized or smaller creatures. A creature suffers [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage every time it starts its turn restrained by a squatting pin.

The [MON] leaps up to [#] ft and lands on its feet in a space it can see. Each creature in the space or within [#] ft of it when it lands must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature in the [MON]'s space that succeeds on this saving throw can choose to be pushed to a space within [#] ft of the [MON] or suffer the consequences of a failed save.

The [MON] vomits tar, covering the ground in a [#] ft square within [#] ft of it. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be covered with tar. The tar ignites if touched by a source of fire or if a creature covered with tar takes fire damage. The tar burns [DURATION] or until a creature uses an action to stop the blaze. A creature that starts its turn in that area or that starts its turn covered with burning tar takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

The [MON] wracks its body, causing the bell to produce an endless piercing ringing. It must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue this ringing and it can end the ringing at any time. While using Endless Ringing it can't move. When a creature enters a space within [#] ft of it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there the creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be deafened and unable to cast spells with verbal components [DURATION].

While animating a pile of wrack has AC [#] and can use Slam and Deluge actions. Also loses its immunity to grappled and restrained conditions and can't fly. If it moves through a creature or object with Incorporeal Movement while animating wrack wrack falls off its ghostly body ending this. Otherwise can end this as bonus action. If it takes [#] or more damage in single turn while animating wrack must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be ejected from wrack ending this.

The [MON] alters the shape of one Medium or smaller wooden object up to 5 ft in any dimension that it can see within [#] ft of it. If the target is being worn or carried, the object's owner must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or the object becomes warped. A warped thrown or ranged weapon or piece of ammunition is rendered useless, while warped melee weapons have disadvantage on attacks. The [MON] can't use this ability to create items that require advanced craftsmanship.

The [MON] leaps up to half its speed horizontally and half its speed vertically without provoking opportunity attacks. If it lands in a space containing one or more creatures, each creature in its space must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and is pushed [#] ft to a space of its choice. If that space is occupied, the creature is knocked prone in its space.

The [MON] empowers its gate seal to dampen teleportation, planar gates, and portals within [#] ft of it. A creature that attempts to teleport while within or into the area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or the teleport fails. Spells and abilities that conjure creatures or objects automatically fail, and portals or gates are suppressed while they remain in that area. The seal lasts [DURATION], or until the [MON] loses concentration on it as if concentrating on a spell.

The [MON] flings a creature it has grappled up to [#] ft in random direction. The creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage per [#] ft it was thrown on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. If the thrown creature would hit another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or split the damage evenly with the thrown creature. A creature that fails either of these saving throws is also knocked prone.

The [MON] begins telling a story, which lasts up to [DURATION] if the [MON] uses a bonus action to continue telling it on subsequent turns. When the story begins, each [MON] within [#] ft of the [MON] that can hear it can use its reaction to make a shove attack against a Medium or smaller creature. Additionally, while the story is being told, each [MON] within [#] ft of the [MON] that can hear it has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks and can shove creatures up to two sizes larger than it.

The [MON] moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter a creature's space. Whenever the [MON] enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed [#] ft back or to the side of the [MON]. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the [MON] enters the creature's space, and the creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and is consumed.

The [MON] primes and throws a device at a point within [#] ft of it. The device explodes when it hits something solid, flinging razor-sharp spikes in a [#] ft radius sphere. Every creature in that area must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. The ground in that area is littered with spikes and becomes difficult terrain. A creature that is knocked prone in that area takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

The [MON] opens a gateway to the celestial plane. The gate appears as a shimmering circle that sheds bright light in a [#] ft radius and dim light for an additional [#] ft and is framed by twisting, golden strands. The gate lasts [DURATION]; though, the [MON] can choose to close it at any time as a bonus action. Once the gate closes, the [MON] is reduced to 0 hit points and remains unconscious [DURATION], awakening, fully restored, at sunrise on the next day. The [MON] can't pass through its own gate.

The [MON] puts creatures to sleep with its haunting melody. While a [MON] sings, it can target one hearing creature within a [#] ft radius. This target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or fall asleep. A sleeping creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Each round the [MON] maintains its song, it can select a new target. The slumbering song even affects elves, but they have advantage on the [ABILITY] saving throw.

After casting an illusion spell of an object, the [MON] temporarily transforms that illusion into a physical, nonmagical object. The temporary object lasts [DURATION], after which it reverts to being an illusion (or vanishes, if the duration of the original illusion expires). During that time, the illusion has all the physical properties of the object it represents, but not magical properties. The [MON] must touch the illusion to trigger this transformation, and the object can be no larger than 5 cubic ft.

The [MON] moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter creatures' spaces. Whenever the [MON] enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed [#] ft back or to the side of the [MON]. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the [MON] enters the creature's space, and the creature takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and is consumed.

The [MON] uses its action to consult its weighty zom for insight. The zom flashes brilliant crimson-and-white light. Each creature within [#] ft of it who can see the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be blinded [DURATION]. Each creature of the [MON]'s choice within [#] ft of it that speaks a language must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Charisma saving throw or be stunned [DURATION] as the [MON] telepathically utters a short expression that is particularly meaningful to that creature.

A [#] ft tall, 1 ft thick, [#] ft diameter ring of fire appears around the [MON] with the [MON] at the center. The fire is opaque to every creature except the [MON]. When the ring of fire appears each creature it intersects must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. A creature takes [#dX] damage the first time each turn it enters the area or when it ends its turn there. The fire lasts [DURATION], or until the [MON] leaves its area.

The [MON] creates a [#] ft radius x [#] ft deep area of quicksand centered on a point it can see within [#] ft of it. A creature that starts its turn in the quicksand or enters area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be grappled by it. Grappled creature must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw at the start of each of its turns or sink 1 ft into the quicksand. A Small creature that sinks at least 2 ft or a Medium creature that sinks at least 3 ft is restrained instead.

The [MON] moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter creatures' spaces. Whenever the [MON] enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to to be pushed [#] ft back or to the side of the [MON]. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the [MON] enters the creature's space, the creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, gains one level of exhaustion, and is consumed.

If the target fails this saving throw and there is at least one unoccupied soul gem on the [MON]'s skull the [MON] regains [#dX] hit points and the target dies instantly. Its soul is trapped in a soul gem on the [MON]'s skull, visible as a tiny creature-shaped mote of light. While its soul is trapped a creature can't be restored to life by any means. A soul that remains in a soul gem [DURATION] is destroyed forever. If the [MON] is defeated and the soul gem is crushed, the creature is restored to life if its body is within 100 miles.

The target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained as it begins to freeze. A restrained creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failed save, or ending the effect on itself on a success. The ice block can be attacked and destroyed (AC [#]; [#] hit points; vulnerability to fire; immunity to poison and psychic), freeing the creature. When the ice block takes any damage other than fire, the petrified creature takes half of the damage dealt to the ice block.

While underwater the [MON] exudes a cloud of ink in a [#] ft radius sphere. The ink extends around corners and the area is heavily obscured [DURATION] or until a strong current dissipates the cloud. Each non-[MON] creature in that area when the cloud appears must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be poisoned [DURATION]. On a success it takes half as much damage. A poisoned creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns. ending the effect on itself on a success.

The [MON] swallows one Medium or smaller ferrous metal object within [#] ft of it. If the object is worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw to prevent this. If the creature wearing or carrying the object is grappled by the [MON], it has disadvantage on this saving throw. Nonmagical objects are digested and destroyed at the start of the [MON]'s next turn. Magic objects remain intact in the [MON]'s stomach [DURATION], then are destroyed. Artifacts are never destroyed in this way.

When underground with its spines exposed, the [MON] can snap its spines closed on one Large, two Medium, or four Small or Tiny creatures above it. Each creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained. A restrained creature can use its action to make a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check to free itself or another restrained creature, ending the effect on itself on a success. Creatures restrained by this trait move with the [MON]. The [MON]'s stinger attack has advantage against creatures restrained by this trait.

The [MON] animates a Large or larger plant within [#] ft of it. The plant is immobile but it acts on the [MON]'s initiative and can make slam attacks or rock attacks if there are rocks to throw within [#] ft of it. Non-plant creatures treat the ground within [#] ft of the plant as difficult terrain as surrounding roots conspire to trip and grasp moving creatures. The plant remains animated [DURATION]. If the [MON] uses this action while it has three plants animated in this way the plant that has been animated the longest returns to normal.

The [MON] chooses up to three creatures it can see within [#] ft of it that are incapacitated or stunned by Deathlights. Each target: [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage (DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] half). Creature stunned by Deathlights has disadvantage on this save. The [MON] then regains hit points equal to half total psychic dealt. A humanoid slain by this rises [DURATION] later as a zombie under the [MON]'s control unless humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The [MON] can have no more than thirty zombies under its control at one time.

The [MON] emits a pungent musk around itself [DURATION]. Each creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be poisoned [DURATION]. A poisoned creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. [DURATION] after a creature fails this saving throw, other creatures have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find or track the creature unless it spends at least [DURATION] washing off the musk.

An opaque wall of flame rises from the ground within [#] ft of the [MON]. The wall is 6 inches thick and can be up to [#] ft high and [#] ft long. Each creature within the wall when it appears must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. A creature also takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The wall disappears when the [MON] is killed or incapacitated, or when it uses an action to dismiss it.

If the [MON]'s stinger sits in water for at least [DURATION], the water becomes poisoned with its toxin. A creature that drinks the poisoned water must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be calmed [DURATION]. A calmed creature feels compelled to stay at the oasis and has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice or recognize danger. A calmed creature that drinks the water again before [DURATION] have passed has disadvantage on the saving throw. The greater restoration spell or similar magic ends the calming effect early.

The [MON] teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within [#] ft of it, leaving behind a wretched puddle in the space it previously occupied. A creature within [#] ft of the space the [MON] left must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be poisoned [DURATION]. The first time a creature enters the puddle's space or if a creature starts its turn in the puddle's space, it takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and is poisoned [DURATION]. The puddle remains [DURATION] or until the [MON] that created it is killed.

The [MON] throws a copper piece into a space within [#] ft of it. A creature that is not hostile to the [MON] that picks up the copper piece is blessed with good luck. At any point within the next [DURATION], the creature can roll a d6 and add the number rolled to one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Alternatively, the bearer of the coin can pass it to another creature of its choice. At any point within the next [DURATION], the new bearer of the coin can roll 2d6 and add the higher result to one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

When a language-using creature suffering ongoing psychic damage targets the [MON] with an attack or spell, the [MON] telepathically prophesies the attackers doom. The attacker must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or gain the doomed condition. It is aware that it will die due to some bizarre circumstance within [DURATION]. In addition to the normal means of removing the condition, this doom can be avoided by a spell that can predict the future, such as augury, contact other plane, or foresight. The [MON] can end the effect as an action.

The [MON] slides down the throat of a sleeping, helpless, or grappled living creature of Medium size or smaller. Once inside, the [MON] takes control of its host, as per the dominate monster spell (Wisdom DC [SAVE_DC] negates). While dominated, the host gains blindsight [#] ft. The host drips blood from its ears, nose, eyes, or from a wound that resembles the injury done to the [MON]'s tree (1 damage/ hour). Damage inflicted on the host has no effect on the [MON]. If the host dies or is reduced to 0 hit points, the [MON] must leave the body within one hour.

The [MON] emits a cloud of freezing fog in a [#] ft radius around it. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Constitution saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be restrained by ice [DURATION]. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage only. A restrained target can use its action to attempt a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check, shattering the ice on a success. The ice can also be attacked and destroyed (AC [#]; [#] hit points; vulnerability to fire and bludgeoning damage; immunity to slashing, cold, poison, and psychic damage).

While on the Ethereal Plane, the [MON] touches a sleeping creature that is under the [MON]'s Curse and is not protected by a magic circle or protection from evil and good spell or similar magic. As long as the touch persists the target has terrible nightmares. If the nightmares last [DURATION] the target gains no benefit from the rest and its hit point max is reduced by [#dX] until the curse ends. If this effect reduces the targets hit point max to 0 the target dies and the [MON] captures its soul. The reduction to the targets hit point max lasts [DURATION].

A future self of the [MON] materializes in an unoccupied space within [#] ft of the [MON]. The future self has the [MON]'s stats and its full hit points, and it takes its turn immediately after its present self. Killing the original [MON] makes its future self disappear. If the present self sees its future self die, the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or suffer one of the following effects [DURATION]. Roll 1d6: (1) frightened; (2) incapacitated; (3) paralyzed; (4) unconscious; (5-6) disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

The [MON] moves or swims up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If this movement would pass through the space of creatures that are not incapacitated or prone, each creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be knocked prone, and the [MON] can enter its space without treating it as difficult terrain. On a success, the [MON] can't enter the creature's space, and the [MON]'s movement ends. If this movement ends while the [MON] is sharing a space with a creature, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

The [MON] rumbles forward stirring up the [MON]. Moves up to [#] ft in straight line and can move through space of any creature. 1st time it enters creature's space during this movement that creature: [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and buried in slushy snow (DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] half damage not buried). Buried creature is restrained and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature including buried creature can use action to free buried creature via DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check. A buried creature with swim speed has advantage on this check.

The [MON] releases seeds from specialized sacs on its tendrils. These seeds sprout into 1d4 green spore pods that reach maturity in [DURATION]. The pods contain noxious spores that are released when the pod is stepped on, picked, or otherwise tampered with. A humanoid or beast that inhales these spores must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw against disease or tendrils start growing inside the creature's body. If the disease is not cured within 3 months, the tendrils take over the creature's nervous system and the victim becomes a tendril puppet.

When the [MON] wraps itself around a creature, the target takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] bludgeoning damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and is grappled (escape DC [SAVE_DC]). The target takes another [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] bludgeoning damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the end of each of its turns when it is still grappled by the [MON]. A [MON] can't attack while it has a creature engulfed. Damage from attacks against the [MON] is split evenly between the [MON] and the engulfed creature; the only exceptions are slashing and psychic damage, which affect only the [MON].

The [MON] asks a question of a creature it can see within [#] ft of it. The target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or either answer the question truthfully and completely or have disadvantage on all attack rolls saves and ability checks for the next [DURATION]. This duration increases cumulatively each time the target fails the save and chooses to take disadvantage. If the target chooses to answer the question, it can't dissemble or omit information relevant to the question being answered. On a success, the [MON] takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

The [MON] is inherently fearful of loud noises, fire, and the color red. It will not choose to move toward any red object or any fiery or burning materials. If presented forcefully with a red object, flame, or if it is dealt fire or thunder damage, the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be frightened [DURATION]. After it has been frightened by a specific red object or a particular source of noise (such as clanging a weapon on a shield) or fire (such as the burning hands spell), the [MON] can't be frightened by that same source again [DURATION].

When the [MON] is first brought below half of its maximum hit points, it immediately recharges its breath weapon, if it is not already available. After doing so, it emanates a green gas that extends in a [#] ft radius around it. When a creature enters this area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. On a failure, a creature with resistance to poison damage loses it, and a creature without resistance or immunity to poison damage becomes vulnerable to poison damage instead. Either effect lasts [DURATION].

The [MON] moves up to its speed in a straight line. While doing so, it can attempt to enter the space of creatures in its path. When it does so, the creature must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw (the creature's choice). If the creature succeeds on a Strength saving throw, the [MON]'s movement ends for the turn. If the creature succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw, it may use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. On a failure on either saving throw, the creature is knocked prone and takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

When the [MON]'s living host has lost three-quarters of its maximum hit points from Blood Drain, the [MON]'s toxins fill the host with an unnatural desire to approach other living beings. When a suitable creature is within [#] ft of it, the [MON] incites a sudden rage in the host, riding the current host to a new host. The current host must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or it attempts to grapple a living creature within [#] ft of it as a reaction. The host can re-attempt this saving throw at the end of each turn that it suffers damage from the [MON]'s Blood Drain.

Falling damage in that area increases to 1d10 per [#] ft fallen. When a creature starts its turn within that area or enters it for the first time in a turn, including when the [MON] creates the field, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained. On a success, the creature's speed is halved as long as it remains in the field. A restrained creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The field persists until the [MON]'s breath recharges, and it can't use Gravitic Breath twice consecutively.

The [MON] opens a fissure in the ground within [#] ft of it that is [#] ft long, [#] ft wide, and 2d4 x [#] ft deep. Each target standing on a spot where a fissure opens must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or fall in. On a success, a creature moves with the fissure's edge as it opens. A fissure that opens beneath a structure causes it to automatically collapse as if the structure was in the area of an earthquake spell. The [MON] can have only one fissure open at a time. If it opens another, the previous fissure closes, shunting all creatures inside it to the surface.

The [MON] summons grasping, thorny vines to impede and drain the life of its foes. The ground within [#] ft of the [MON] becomes difficult terrain [DURATION]. This difficult terrain doesn't cost the [MON] extra movement. A creature that enters or starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained by the plants. A restrained creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature, including the restrained target, can take its action to break the target free of the vines by succeeding on a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check.

While on the Ethereal Plane, the [MON] touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane. A protection from evil and good spell cast on the target prevents this contact, as does a magic circle. As long as the contact persists, the target has dreadful visions. If these visions last for at least [DURATION], the target gains no benefit from its rest, and its hit point max is reduced by [#dX]. If this effect reduces the target's hit point max to 0, the target dies, and if the target was evil, its soul is trapped in the [MON]'s soul bag. The reduction to the target's hit point max lasts [DURATION].

The [MON] covers itself and anything it is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes it look like another creature of its general size and humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the [MON] takes a bonus action to end it or if it dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the [MON] could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching its would feel its rough flesh. Otherwise, a creature must use an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the [MON] is disguised.

The [MON] molds the ground near it, causing a wall of rock to rise from ground at a point it can see within [#] ft of it. Wall is up to [#] ft long 5 ft high and 5 ft thick. It can be any shape as long as its base is connected to the ground. If wall cuts through creature's space when it appears creature is pushed to one side (the [MON]'s choice). If creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall it can make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. On success it can use its reaction to move up to its speed so it is not enclosed by the wall. Wall lasts [DURATION] or until the [MON] creates new wall.

The [MON] launches harpoon-like pseudopod shaped like pointed object (ex: stalagtite) at a creature in its space. The target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] or [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] piercing damage, and pseudopod stuck in it. While pseudopod is stuck target restrained and [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of each of its turns the [MON] can use bonus action to pull target up to [#] ft to its nearest wall ceiling or similar surface. Creature including target can use action to detach pseudopod via DC [SAVE_DC] Str. If the target detaches harpoon while stuck to the [MON]'s ceiling: normal fall damage.

The [MON] leaps out of the water to crash down onto a target with devastating effect. The [MON] must move [#] ft in a straight line toward its target before jumping. When jumping, the [MON] travels up to [#] ft through the air before landing. Any creature occupying the space where the [MON] lands takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and becomes submerged [#] ft below the surface of the water. The targets that succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw take half as much damage, and are not submerged, but are moved to the nearest unoccupied space. Boats and structures are not immune to this attack.

As long as the [MON] is within [#] ft of at least one other [MON], each [MON] in range can use this action at the same time to join together to create a [MON] that is one size category larger than the largest [MON] that created it. The new [MON]'s hit points total is equal to the combined hit points total of all the [MON]s, and it is affected by any conditions, spells, and other magical effects currently affecting any of the [MON]s. The new [MON] acts on the same initiative count as the [MON]s that formed it and occupies any unoccupied space that previously contained at least one of the [MON]s that formed it.

While inside a spellbook, the [MON] eats one spell of the highest level present then exits the spellbook. It chooses to either make its next Paste attack with a number of damage dice equal to the eaten spell's level or regain [#] hit points per spell level. The [MON] can only eat one spell at a time and must use the devoured spell's energy before attempting to enter another spellbook. The eaten spell's entry is garbled, but the owner can repair it for half the gold and time usually spent to copy a spell. If the owner has the spell prepared, it can re-record the spell during a long rest for no additional cost.

The [MON] lobs a sphere of concentrated dye that explodes on impact marking creatures caught in its effect. Each creature within a [#] ft radius of where sphere landed must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be brightly painted [DURATION]. Any attack roll against creature has advantage if attacker can see it and other creatures have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check made to find the marked creature. To remove the effect a creature must spend [DURATION] bathing. Alternatively spells that create water or clean objects such as prestidigitation also remove the effect.

While the [MON] is covering an object or structure, it can rapidly collapse back to its normal form, ending the stretch and spraying all nearby creatures with poisonous slime. Each creature within [#] ft of any space the stretched [MON] occupied before collapsing must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be coated in poisonous slime. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage only. A coated creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of each of its turns. A coated creature or a creature within [#] ft of it can use an action to clean the slime off.

If the [MON] jumps at least [#] ft as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed out of the [MON]'s space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead is knocked prone in the [MON]'s space.

A meteor explodes at a point the [MON] can see [#] ft directly above it. Each creature within [#] ft of it that can see the meteor (other than the [MON]) must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be blinded [DURATION]. Four fiery chunks of the meteor then plummet to the ground, landing within [#] ft of the [MON] and exploding in [#] ft radius blasts. Each creature in an area of an explosion must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. A creature in more than one area is affected only once.

The [MON] gestures at a point on the ground it can see within [#] ft of it. A fountain of molten rock erupts from that point in a [#] ft radius cylinder that is [#] ft high. The area is difficult terrain [DURATION]. Each creature in the cylinder must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be coated in hardened lava. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature coated in hardened lava has its speed halved while it remains coated. The coated creature or a creature within [#] ft of it can use its action to break and remove the hardened lava, ending the effect.

The [MON] corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within [#] ft of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1 ft cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw to avoid the [MON]'s touch. If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, its takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.

Up to four chains the [MON] can see within [#] ft of it sprout razor-edged barbs and animate under the [MON]'s control, provided that the chains aren't being worn or carried. Each animated chain is an object with AC [#], [#] hit points, resistance to piercing damage, and immunity to psychic and thunder damage. When the [MON] uses Multiattack on its turn, it can use each animated chain to make one additional chain attack. An animated chain can grapple one creature of its own but can't make attacks while grappling. An animated chain reverts to its inanimate state if reduced to 0 hit points or if the [MON] is incapacitated or dies.

The [MON] stashes a Medium or smaller creature grappled by its or that is incapacitated within [#] ft of its inside extradimensional pocket in its parka ending grappled/incapacitated condition. Extradimensional pocket can hold only one creature at a time. While inside pocket creature blinded and restrained and has total cover against attacks and other effects outside pocket. Trapped creature can use action to escape pocket via DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check and using 5 ft of move falling prone in unoccupied space within [#] ft of the [MON]. If [MON] dies trapped creature is freed appearing in unoccupied space within [#] ft of the [MON]'s body.

The [MON] performs an ancient, nihilistic joke of necromantic power. This joke has no effect on constructs or undead. All other creatures within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail are knocked prone in a fit of deadly laughter. The laughter lasts [DURATION], during which time the victim is incapacitated and unable to stand up from prone. At the end of its turn each round, an incapacitated victim must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points. The laughter can be ended early by rendering the victim unconscious or with greater restoration or similar magic.

The [MON] molds the ground near it, causing a rift to form in the ground at a point it can see within [#] ft of it. Rift can be up to [#] ft wide up to [#] ft long and up to [#] ft deep and can be any shape. Each creature standing on a spot where fissure opens must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or fall in. Creature that successfully saves moves with fissure's edge as it opens. Fissure that opens beneath a structure causes it to automatically collapse as if structure was in the area of an earthquake spell. It can have only one fissure open at a time. If it opens another previous fissure closes shunting all creatures inside it to surface.

A [MON] under duress creates clones of itself at the beginning of its turn. Each round [DURATION], the number of live [MON]s quadruples but never exceeds 20. Each duplicate appears in the same space as any other rat, can either move or use an action the round it appears, and has [#] hit points and AC [#]. Any surviving duplicates perish [DURATION] after the first ones were created. If the original [MON] dies, its clones stop duplicating but the preexisting clones remain until their time expires. A creature can identify the original [MON] from its duplicates as an action by making a successful DC [SAVE_DC] Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Perception) check.

If the [MON] burrows at least [#] ft as part of its movement, it can use this action to emerge in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures and each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage damage and is pushed up to [#] ft out of the [MON]'s space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead is knocked prone in the [MON]'s space. The area within [#] ft of the [MON] then becomes difficult terrain.

While climbing on a wall or ceiling made of worked stone, the [MON] injects its acid into the mortar, weakening the structure. Each creature within [#] ft of the wall or in a [#] ft cube beneath the ceiling must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails its saving throw when beneath a ceiling is also knocked prone and buried. The buried target is restrained and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature, including the target, can take its action to remove the rubble and free the buried target by succeeding on a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check.

If the [MON] doesn't have all of its hit points, it flexes and roars, spraying blood from its wounds. Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and goes berserk. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage, and doesn't go berserk. On each of its turns, a berserk creature must succeed on a melee attack the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the berserk creature attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once a creature goes berserk, it continues to do so [DURATION], until it regains all of its hit points, or [DURATION].

The [MON] creates magical darkness and silence around it in a [#] ft radius sphere that moves with it and spreads around corners. The dark silence lasts [DURATION]. The [MON] sees objects in the sphere in shades of gray. Darkvision can't penetrate the darkness, no natural light can illuminate it, no sound can be created within or pass through it, and any creature or object entirely inside the sphere of dark silence is immune to thunder damage. Creatures entirely inside the darkness are deafened and can't cast spells that include a verbal component.
