If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of level [#] or lower, the spell creating the light is destroyed.

The [MON] causes a permanent, [#] ft tall, [#] ft radius spire of rock to rise from a point on the ground within [#] ft of it. A creature in the spire's area when it appears must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more is impaled and restrained at the top of the spire. A creature can use an action to make a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check, freeing the impaled creature on a success. The impaled creature is also freed if the spire is destroyed. The spire is an object with AC [#], [#] hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

A magical, 5 ft wide, [#] ft tall whirlwind appears in a space the [MON] can see within [#] ft of it. The whirlwind may appear in another creature's space. If the whirlwind appears in another creature's space, or when it enters a creature's space for the first time on a turn, the creature must make a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check, becoming restrained by the whirlwind on a failure. The whirlwind may restrain one creature at a time. A creature within [#] ft of the whirlwind (including the restrained creature) can use an action to make a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check, freeing the restrained creature on a success. A freed creature can move to an unoccupied space within [#] ft of the whirlwind.

The [MON] preserves up to Medium creature grappled by it: can't breathe restrained as it freezes. Restrained creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw at its next turn end. Fail: [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage is petrified in the [MON] Cavity total cover from attacks/effects outside. If this damage reduces it to 0 hit points creature automatically stable. Petrified creature removed from Cavity thaws ending petrification in [DURATION] or immediately after taking fire damage. Success: half as much damage, and ejected landing prone in unoccupied space within [#] ft of golem. If golem moves preserved creature moves with it. Can't use Preserve Creature if the [MON] Cavity is frozen.

The [MON] uses half its movement to enter a book. If the book is being worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or the [MON] enters the book. A creature can take its action to find the [MON] in a book by succeeding on a DC [SAVE_DC] Intelligence (Investigation) check. If successful, a creature can use a bonus action to tear out the pages where the [MON] is hiding, forcing the [MON] out of the book and into an unoccupied space within [#] ft of it Alternatively, a creature can destroy the book with a successful melee attack, dealing half of the damage to the [MON] and forcing it out of the book into an unoccupied space within [#] ft of it.

action.ability_tags: Charming, Difficult Terrain, Extra Damage, Zero Speed
action.desc: As an action, the [MON] can dig its roots into the ground, securing itself in place and causing the area in a [#] ft radius around it to be shrouded in shadow. While rooted in this way, the [MON]'s speed becomes 0, it can't be knocked prone, and its attacks deal an extra [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. This area is difficult terrain and nonmagical sources of light are only half as effective while within it. Small and smaller beasts with Intelligence 3 or lower in that area lose their natural coloration and turn pale grey. These creatures are charmed by the [MON] while within that area. Plants and trees inside the area turn an ashen color. The [MON] can recall its roots and end this effect as a bonus action.

The [MON] opens a momentary rupture in the eldritch source that fuels its words of power. This rupture appears at a spot designated by the [MON] within [#] ft of it. Any creature within [#] ft of the spot must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, is knocked prone, and is pulled 1d6 x [#] ft toward the eldritch singularity, taking an additional [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage per [#] ft they were dragged. If the saving throw succeeds, the target takes half as much force damage and isn't knocked prone or pulled. The spot where the rupture occurs becomes the center of a [#] ft radius antimagic field [DURATION]. The [MON]'s spells are not affected by this antimagic field.

The anchor-shaped organ atop the [MON]'s head emits a burst of blue light. Each hostile creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be outlined in blue light [DURATION]. While outlined in blue light, a creature can't breathe underwater. This effect dispels spells such as water breathing and temporarily suppresses water breathing granted through magic items or a creature's natural physiology. In addition, the [MON] and creatures friendly to the [MON] have advantage on attack rolls against creatures outlined in blue light. A creature outlined in blue light can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

The [MON] moves up to [#] ft in a straight line toward a creature, moving through the space of any creature in its path and stopping when it is within [#] ft of the target. Each ally within [#] ft of the [MON] can use its reaction to move up to [#] ft in the same direction, also moving through the space of any creature in its path and stopping when it is within [#] ft of the target. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. The target and each creature within [#] ft of it must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. For each additional creature that participated in this movement, the damage increases by [#dX].

Partially submerges in the ground and slithers forward scooping up soil and creatures as it goes. The [MON] moves up to [#] ft in a straight line and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this movement that creature: [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and is buried as it is swallowed bounced through the hollow inside of the [MON] and deposited back in its space under a pile of soil (DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] half damage and isn't buried). A buried creature is restrained and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature including the buried creature can take its action to free the buried creature by succeeding on a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check.

If three or more [MON]s are within [#] ft of each other, they can use their reactions to start a cacophony. Each creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of one of the [MON]s and that can hear it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or have disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check. The DC increases by 1 for each [MON] participating in the cacophony to a maximum of DC [SAVE_DC]. To join or maintain an existing cacophony, a [MON] must use its bonus action on its turn and end its turn within [#] ft of another [MON] participating in the cacophony. The cacophony ends when fewer than three [MON] maintain it. A [MON] can still speak and cast spells with verbal components while participating in a cacophony.

The [MON] peels the face off one grappled foe. The target must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the face is torn off; the target takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage and is stunned [DURATION]. If the save succeeds, the target takes half as much damage only. Heal, regeneration, or similar magic restores the stolen features; other curative magic forms a mass of scar tissue. The peeled-off face is a tiny, animated object (as the spell, but it can't attack) under the [MON]'s control. It retains the former owner's memories and personality. The [MON]s keep such faces as trophies, but they can also wear someone's face to gain advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to imitate the face's former owner.

The [MON] emits a magical howl that changes in melody and frequency depending on the amount of light around it. Each creature of the [MON]'s choice within [#] ft of it that can hear it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or succumb to the corresponding effect. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to that effect [DURATION]. (1) Bright Howl: When the [MON] is in bright light, each target that fails the save is incapacitated [DURATION]. (2) Dim Howl: When the [MON] is in dim light, each target that fails the save is stunned [DURATION]. (3) Dark Howl: When the [MON] is in darkness, each target that fails the save drops whatever it is holding and is paralyzed with fear [DURATION].

A [#] ft radius, [#] ft tall cylinder of swirling air forms on a point the [MON] can see within [#] ft of it. The whirlwind lasts as long as the [MON] maintains concentration (as if concentrating on a spell). Any creature but the [MON] that enters the whirlwind must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained by it. The [MON] can move the whirlwind up to [#] ft as an action, and creatures restrained by the whirlwind move with it. The whirlwind ends if the [MON] loses sight of it. A creature can use its action to free a creature restrained by the whirlwind, including itself, by succeeding on a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check. If the check succeeds, the creature is no longer restrained and moves to the nearest space outside the whirlwind.

The [MON] creates three illusory duplicates of itself if it isn't in bright light. The duplicates move with it and mimic its actions, shifting position so as to make it impossible to track which [MON] is the real one. If the [MON] is ever in an area of bright light, the duplicates disappear. Whenever any creature targets the [MON] with an attack or a harmful spell while a duplicate remains, that creature rolls randomly to determine whether it targets the [MON] or one of the duplicates. A creature is unaffected by this magical effect if it can't see or if it relies on senses other than sight. A duplicate has the [MON]'s AC and uses its saving throws. If an attack hits a duplicate, or if a duplicate fails a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, the duplicate disappears.

The [MON] emits foul-smelling musk in a [#] ft cone that lingers [DURATION]. When a creature starts its turn in that area or enters that area for the first time on a turn, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or become drenched in musk. On a success, the creature can use its reaction to move to the nearest unoccupied space outside the cone. If it doesn't have a reaction available or chooses not to exit the cone immediately, it is also drenched in musk. A creature saturated in musk is poisoned [DURATION] or until it spends [DURATION] thoroughly washing itself, its clothes, and its equipment with water and soap. In addition, each creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of a saturated creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Constitution saving throw or be poisoned [DURATION].

As long as at least one if its living figureheads remains intact, the [MON] can cause the figurehead to wail. Roll a d6 and consult the following table to determine the wail. (1-2) Frightening Wail. Each creature within [#] ft of it who can hear the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Wisdom saving throw or be frightened [DURATION]. A frightened creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. (3-4) Maddening Wail. Each creature within [#] ft of it who can hear the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Wisdom saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. (5-6) Stunning Wail. Each creature within [#] ft of it who can hear the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be stunned [DURATION].

The [MON] targets one creature with 0 hit points that it can see within [#] ft of it. If the creature is alive, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or die and have its soul drawn into the [MON]'s greatsword. If the creature is dead and has been dead for less than [DURATION], its soul is automatically captured. When the [MON] captures a soul, it regains [#] hit points, and Reave Soul recharges at the start of its next turn. While a creature's soul is trapped, that creature can't be returned to life by any means short of a wish spell. A banishment spell targeted at the greatsword forces the [MON] to make a Charisma saving throw against the spell. On a failed save, any souls trapped in the blade are released instead of the spell's normal effect. Trapped souls are also released when the [MON] dies.

The [MON] transforms into a vortex of swirling, churning water [DURATION]. This ability can be used only while the [MON] is underwater, and the [MON] can't leave the water while in vortex form. While in vortex form, The [MON] enter another creature's space and stop there in vortex form. In this liquid form, the [MON] still takes normal damage from weapons and magic. A creature in the same space as the [MON] at the start of the creature's turn takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage unless it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. If the creature is Medium or smaller, a failed saving throw also means it is grappled (escape DC [SAVE_DC]). [DURATION], the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. If the saving throw succeeds, the target is pushed out of the [MON]'s space.

The [MON] emits a magical roar. Each time it roars before finishing a long rest, the roar is louder and the effect is different: (1) First Roar: Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] that can hear it [OUTCOME]. A frightened creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. (2) Second Roar: Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] that can hear it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be deafened, frightened, and paralyzed [DURATION]. An affected creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. (3) Third Roar: Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] that can hear it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be knocked prone.

The flesh of a [MON] putrefies and dissolves rapidly when soaked with water in the following ways must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking. Splashed with a waterskin or equivalent must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] damage. Attacked by creature made of water must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking normal damage plus an extra [#dX] damage. Caught in rain must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] damage per round (DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw for half). Immersed in water must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] damage per round (DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw for half) alternatively, the saving throw and DC of the spell used to conjure or control the water damaging the [MON] can be used in place of the saving throws above.

The future self must make a time warping staff attack against a target. If the attack hits, instead of causing bludgeoning damage, both the target and the attacker jump forward through time, effectively ceasing to exist in the present time. They reappear in the same locations [DURATION] later, at the end of the present self's turn. Creatures occupying those locations at that moment are pushed 5 ft in a direction of their own choosing. The target of the drift (but not the future self) must then make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, with effects identical to those for the [MON] witnessing the death of its future self (see Drift Backward). The future self doesn't reappear after using this ability the second time; only the target of the drift reappears from the second use. This does not trigger a saving throw for the present self.

A [#] ft radius, [#] ft tall cylinder of sand forms on a point the [MON] can see within [#] ft of it. The dust devil lasts as long as the [MON] maintains concentration (as if a spell). Any creature but the [MON] that enters the dust devil must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained by it; any number of creatures may be restrained this way. At the start of a restrained creature's turn, it takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. The [MON] can move the dust devil up to [#] ft as an action; restrained creatures move with it. The dust devil ends if the [MON] loses sight of it. A creature can use its action to free a creature restrained by the dust devil, including itself, by making a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check. If the check succeeds, it moves to the nearest space outside the dust devil.

Bands of shadow stretch out from the [MON] and wrap around a target it can see within [#] ft of it. The target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be translocated to the Plane of Shadow [DURATION], as the banishment spell. An affected creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. When a target exits the shroud, it appears in an unoccupied space within [#] ft of the [MON]. The [MON] can have only one target in its shroud at a time. It can release a target as a bonus action. While in the Plane of Shadow, the target is bombarded with horrific images and sensations. Each round it remains in the Plane of Shadow, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or gain one short-term madness. A target held in the shroud is released when the [MON] dies.

The [MON] creates a sandstorm in a cylinder [#] ft high, that reaches to within [#] ft of it. The storm moves with the [MON]. The area is heavily obscured, and each creature other than a [MON] that enters the sandstorm or ends its turn there must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained by it. Also, each creature other than a [MON] that ends its turn inside the sandstorm takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage. The [MON] can maintain the haboob [DURATION] as if concentrating on a spell. While maintaining the haboob, the [MON]'s speed is reduced to 5 ft and it can't sand step. Creatures restrained by the sandstorm move with the [MON]. A creature can free itself or an adjacent creature from the sandstorm by using its action and making a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check. A successful check ends the restraint on the target creature.

If the [MON] isn't in sun light or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form. While in bat form, the [MON] can't speak, its walking speed is [#] ft, and it has a flying speed of [#] ft. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. While in mist form, the [MON] can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of [#] ft, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

The [MON] grabs a creature or item. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be grappled (escape DC [SAVE_DC]). The [MON] can then move up to its speed as a bonus action. The grappled creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be pulled along [#] ft behind the [MON]. A creature being dragged by the [MON] must make attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws with disadvantage. If the target is an object or weapon being held by another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, or the [MON] pulls the object away from the creature. After stealing an object or weapon, the [MON] can move up to its speed as a bonus action. The [MON] can only grapple one creature or hold one weapon or object at a time. If holding a weapon, it can use its Tail Grab action to make one attack with the weapon with no proficiency bonus.

The [MON] releases a magnetic pulse, pulling metal objects toward itself. Objects made of gold or silver are unaffected. Each creature that is wearing metal armor or holding a metal weapon within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or the metal items worn or carried by it stick to the [MON]. A creature that is made of metal or is wearing metal armor and that fails the saving throw is stuck to the [MON] and grappled (escape DC [SAVE_DC]). If the item is a weapon and the wielder can't or won't let go of the weapon, the wielder is stuck to the [MON] and grappled (escape DC [SAVE_DC]). A stuck object can't be used. Grappled and stuck creatures and objects move with the [MON] when it moves. A creature can take its action to remove one creature or object from the [MON] by succeeding on a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check. The [MON]'s AC increases by 1 for each creature grappled in this way.

action.ability_tags: Aura, Damage Reduction, Magic Disrupting, Self Healing
action.desc: The [MON] surrounds itself with a magical, rune-covered, glowing, translucent aura in a [#] ft radius. The aura moves with the [MON] and casts dim light inside its area. The aura disappears at the beginning of the [MON]'s next turn. The [MON] can choose one of the following options: (1) Spell Shield: Any spell cast with a 5th-level or lower spell slot from outside the aura can't affect anything inside the aura. Using a spell to target something inside the aura or include the auras space in an area has no effect on anything inside. (2) Damage Shield: Whenever the [MON] would take damage, the aura takes the damage instead, and the aura visibly weakens. It has [#] hit points. If the damage reduces the aura to 0 hit points, the aura disappears, and the [MON] takes any excess damage. (3) Death Aura: Each living creature that ends its turn inside the aura takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and the [MON] regains the same number of hit points.

If the [MON] successfully hits a beast with an Intelligence of 3 or lower with its Slam attack, it latches onto the [MON]'s head and attempts to take control of the creature. The target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be bonded with the [MON], losing all control of its body to the [MON]. While bonded in this way, the [MON]'s statistics are replaced by the statistics of the [MON], including the [MON]'s hit points and Hit Dice, but the [MON] retains its alignment, personality, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, along with its Speak with beasts trait. In addition, the [MON] retains its ability to cast spells. The [MON] can't be targeted specifically while bonded with a creature. It can detach itself from the creature and end the bond by spending 5 ft of its movement. If the bonded creature is reduced to 0 hit points, the [MON] is ejected from it and appears in an unoccupied space within [#] ft of the creature.

action.ability_tags: Disadvantage, Disarming, Healing, Poisoning, Random Effects, Toppling
action.desc: The [MON] plucks cloves from its head and throws them at up to three creatures it can see within [#] ft of it, making a separate ranged attack roll for each target. A creature can choose to let this attack roll hit automatically. On a hit, roll a d4. A creature friendly to the [MON] adds 1 to the result, while hostile creatures subtract 1 from the result. The creature then is affected as follows: (0) Worst Fortune: Whatever the target is holding slips from its grasp into a random space within [#] ft of the target, and the target is knocked prone. (1) Bad Fortune: The target takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be poisoned [DURATION]. (2) Adverse Fortune: The target has disadvantage on its next attack roll. (3) Favorable Fortune: The target has advantage on its next attack roll. (4) Good Fortune: The target regains [#dX] hit points. (5) Best Fortune: The target's next successful hit is critical.

The [MON] turns a [#] ft cube of natural mud or loose stone into a pit of quicksand. Each creature in that area when the [MON] creates the pit must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or sink 1d4 ft into the quicksand and become restrained. A creature that successfully saves moves to the pit is edge as it is formed. A creature that enters the quicksand for the first time on a turn or starts its turn in the quicksand it sinks 1d4 ft and is restrained. A creature that is completely submerged in quicksand can't breathe. A restrained creature can try to escape by taking an action to attempt a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within [#] ft of the edge of the quicksand. A creature within [#] ft of the quicksand can use an action to pull a creature out of the quicksand. Doing so requires a successful DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check, and the [MON] has advantage on attack rolls against the creature [DURATION].

The [MON] touches a petrified creature or nonmagical object or structure made of crystal or stone within [#] ft of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, this touch destroys a 6-inch cube of it and the [MON] regains [#dX] hit points. If the object is being worn or carried, its owner can make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw to avoid the [MON]'s touch. If the target is a petrified creature, it must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. The [MON] regains hit points equal to half the damage taken. Being petrified doesn't give a creature resistance to this damage. If the object touched provides a bonus to AC, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to AC it offers. Armor reduced to AC 10 or shield that drops to +0 bonus is destroyed. If object touched is a held stone weapon it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If penalty drops to -5 it is destroyed.

The [MON] leaps up to [#] ft through the air and must succeed on a claw attack against a target within reach. If it hits, the target must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or its soul is forced out of its body, appearing [#] ft in a random direction away from its body, [DURATION]. The creature has control of its soul, which is invisible and can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, but it can't cast spells or take any actions. The creature's body is knocked unconscious and can't be awoken until its soul returns, but it can take damage as normal. An affected creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, reoccupying its body on a success. Alternatively, a creature can reoccupy its body early if it starts its turn within [#] ft of its body. If a creature doesn't return to its body within [DURATION], the creature dies. If its body is reduced to 0 hit points before the creature reoccupies its body, the creature dies.

The [MON] emits a cloud of sweet-smelling pheromones within [#] ft of it. A giant, humanoid, or beast that starts its turn inside the aura must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be charmed [DURATION]. A charmed creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature fails the saving throw three times in [DURATION], it is charmed [DURATION] and obeys the [MON]'s verbal or telepathic commands. If the creature suffers harm from the [MON] or its allies or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. The [MON] can have no more than six creatures charmed at a time. The [MON] can end its charm on a creature at any time (no action required). If the [MON] has six creatures charmed and a seventh creature fails its saving throw, the [MON] can choose to release its charm on another creature to replace it with the new creature or to have the new creature unaffected by the aura.

If the [MON] starts its turn on its chosen burial ground, it sinks into the earth. If it has a creature grappled, that creature sinks with the [MON]. A Medium or larger creature sinks up to its waist; a Small creature sinks up to its neck. If the [MON] still has the victim grappled at the start of the [MON]'s next turn, both of them disappear into the earth. While buried in this way, a creature is considered stunned. It can free itself with a successful DC [SAVE_DC] Strength (Athletics) check, but only one check is allowed; if it fails, the creature is powerless to aid itself except with magic. The creature must also make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw; if it succeeds, the creature has a lungful of air and can hold its breath for (Constitution modifier + 1) minutes before suffocation begins. Otherwise, it begins suffocating immediately. allies equipped with digging tools can reach it in four minutes divided by the number of diggers; someone using an improvised tool (a sword, a plate, bare hands) counts as only one-half of a digger.

The [MON] separates itself into two identical copies for up to [DURATION]. The new [MON]s' hit points totals are equal to the original [MON]'s hit points total divided by 2 (rounded down), and each is affected by any conditions, spells, and other magical effects that affected the original [MON]. The new [MON]s otherwise retain the same statistics as the original, except neither has this action. The new [MON]s act on the same initiative count as the original [MON] and occupy any unoccupied spaces within [#] ft of the original [MON]'s space. If one [MON] starts its turn within [#] ft of its other half, they can each use their reactions to recombine. The recombined [MON]'s hit points total is equal to the combined hit points total of the two [MON]s, and it is affected by any conditions, spells, and other magical effects currently affecting either of the combining [MON]s. The [MON] automatically recombines if both of its halves are still alive at the end of the duration. If only one [MON] remains alive at the end of the duration, it gains this action after it finishes a long rest.

A creature hosting a [MON]'s astral form must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw each time it finishes a long rest. On a success, the [MON] is ejected from the host and the Astral Plane into an unoccupied space in the Material Plane within [#] ft of the host and is stunned [DURATION]. On a failure, the [MON] consumes part of the host's internal organs, reducing the host's Constitution score by [#dX]. The host dies if this reduces its Constitution to 0. The reduction lasts until the host finishes a long rest after the [MON] has been expelled. If the host's Constitution score is reduced to 0, the [MON] exits the host's body in the Material Plane by tearing its way out through the abdomen. The [MON] becomes completely corporeal as it exits the host, stepping out of the host at its full size. From the time the [MON] succeeds on the initial dive into the host through the Astral Plane until the moment it emerges from the host's abdomen, it can be seen by any creature that can see into the Astral Plane-its head buried in the host's back. The [MON] has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and is effectively stunned when in this position [DURATION].

As an action, the [MON] can attempt to take control of a creature it can see within [#] ft of it, forcing an exchange of souls as a magic jar spell, using its own body as the container. The [MON] can use this power at will, but it can exchange souls with only one other creature at a time. The victim resists the attack with a successful DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw. A creature that successfully saves is immune to the same [MON]'s soul exchange [DURATION]. If the saving throw fails, the [MON] takes control of the target's body and ferociously attacks nearby opponents, eyes blazing with otherworldly light. As an action, the [MON] can shift from its host body back to its own, if it is within range, returning the victim's soul to its own body. If the host body or [MON] is brought to 0 hit points within [#] ft of each other, the two souls return to their original bodies and the creature at 0 hit points is dying; it must make death saving throws until it dies, stabilizes, or regains hit points, as usual. If the host body or [MON] is slain while they are more than [#] ft apart, their souls can't return to their bodies and they are both slain. While trapped in the [MON]'s withered body, the victim is effectively paralyzed and helpless.

The [MON] enters the body of an incapacitated or dead creature by crawling into its mouth and other orifices. Inhabiting takes [DURATION], and the victim must be Small, Medium, or Large. If The [MON] inhabits a dead body, it can animate it and control its movements, effectively becoming a zombie for as long as it remains inside. The [MON] can abandon the body as an action. Attacks against the host deal half damage to the [MON] as well, but [MON]'s resistances and immunities still apply against this damage. In a living victim, the [MON] can control the victim's movement and actions as if using dominate monster (save DC [SAVE_DC]) on the victim. The [MON] can consume a living victim; the target takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage per hour while the [MON] inhabits its body, and the [MON] regains hit points equal to the damage dealt. When inhabiting a body, the [MON] can choose to have any spell it casts with a range of self, target the inhabited body rather than itself. The skin of a creature inhabited by the [MON] crawls with the forms of the insects inside. The [MON] can hide this telltale sign with a Charisma (Deception) check against a viewer's passive Insight. A greater restoration spell or similar magic forces the [MON] to abandon the host.

When a [MON] chooses a house to inhabit, it scrawls a symbol on a wall, baseboard, cupboard, or semi-permanent object (like a stove) to be its tiny domain. This ability creates a hidden extra-dimensional dwelling. After creating a hidey-hole, a [MON] can teleport itself and up to 50 lb of objects to the designated location instead of making a normal move. This extradimensional space can only be entered by the [MON] or by a creature using a plane shift spell or ability. The location can be determined by casting detect magic in the area of the sigil, but it takes a successful DC [SAVE_DC] Intelligence (Arcana) check to plane shift into the space. Inside the hidey-hole, a [MON] can see what is going on outside the space through a special sensor. This sensor functions like a window, and it can be blocked by mundane objects placed in front of the sigil. If it leaves an item in its space, it remains there even if it removes the sigil and places it in another location. If someone else removes the sigil, all contents are emptied into the Ethereal Plane (including any beings within its hidey-hole at the time). In this case, the [MON] can attempt a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw to instead eject itself (but none of its possessions) into a space adjacent to the sigil.

action.ability_tags: Blinding, Difficult Terrain, Obscuring, Poisoning, Random Effects, Restraining
action.desc: The [MON] unleashes a random magical attack. Roll a d4 to determine the effect: (1) Mutant Plants: Grasping tendrils of alien vegetation sprout from the ground in a [#] ft radius centered on a point the [MON] can see within [#] ft of it. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each target in that area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained, as by the entangle spell. The plants wither away after [DURATION]. (2) Acid Rain: Corrosive acid falls from the sky centered on a point the [MON] can see within [#] ft of it. Each creature in a [#] ft radius, [#] ft high cylinder must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. (3) Noxious Cloud: The [MON] creates a [#] ft radius sphere of reddish, stinging mist centered on a point it can see within [#] ft of it. The area is heavily obscured, and each creature inside the cloud at the start of its turn must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be blinded [DURATION]. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage only. The cloud lasts [DURATION]. (4) Shrinking Ray: A bright green ray strikes a single creature within [#] ft of it. The creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be shrunk to half its size, as by the enlarge/reduce spell. The creature returns to its normal size after [DURATION].

action.ability_tags: Blinding, Charming, Incapacitating, Knockout, Poisoning, Random Effects, Shapechanging
action.desc: The [MON] raises its tail and sprays an alchemical mixture. The [MON] is immune to its own spray effects and to the spray effects of other [MON]s. Roll a d6 to determine the [MON]'s spray. (1) Pleasant Mist: The [MON] produces a rosy mist. Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be charmed by it [DURATION]. (2) Shrinking Cloud: The [MON] releases a yellow gas. Each creature in a [#] ft cone must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be reduced as if targeted by the enlarge/reduce spell [DURATION]. A target can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. (3) Laughing Gas: The [MON] emits a sparkling orange cloud. Each creature in a [#] ft cone must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be incapacitated by laughter [DURATION]. An incapacitated creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. (4) Blinding Spray: The [MON] shoots a stream of a green fluid. Each creature in a line that is [#] ft long and [#] ft wide must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be blinded [DURATION], or until the creature uses an action to wipe its eyes. (5) Sleeping Fog: The [MON] sprays a sweet-smelling blue fog. Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or fall unconscious [DURATION]. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it awake. (6) Poison Fog: The [MON] excretes a foul-smelling purple fog around itself [DURATION]. Each creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be poisoned [DURATION].

The [MON] holds 20 gallons of ale. If it runs out of ale or empties itself from ale blast, the [MON]'s speed is reduced to 0 and it has disadvantage on all attack rolls until it is refilled with at least 1 gallon of ale.

If the [MON]'s birth site hasn't been purified by holy rites, a destroyed [MON] gains a new body in [DURATION], regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within [#] ft of its birth site.

If the [MON]'s mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to take half damage with a successful Dexterity saving throw, the mount instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and half damage if it fails.

The [MON] has the ability to travel between shadows as if by means of a dimension door spell. The magical transport must begin and end in an area with at least some dim light. The shadow door can span a maximum of [#] ft.

The [MON] is bound to an amulet. It knows the distance and direction to the amulet while it is on the same plane of existence. Whoever wears the amulet becomes the [MON]'s master and can command the [MON] to travel to it.

The [MON] normally glows as brightly as a torch. The creature can dim itself to the luminosity of a candle, but it can't extinguish its light. Because of its glow, the [MON] has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

The [MON] selects up to 6 creatures within [#] ft of it and grants them advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), or Charisma (Performance) checks. The [MON] chooses which skill for each recipient.

If the [MON] dies within its bound region before the catastrophe it heralds happens, the [MON] returns to life in [DURATION] and regains all its hit points. The [MON] dies after the catastrophe ends and doesn't rejuvenate.

Whenever the [MON] deals [DMG_TYPE] damage to a living creature with blood in its body, the creature's hit point max is reduced by the same amount and the [MON] regains hit points equal to half the [DMG_TYPE] damage dealt.

A living creature that is injured by or makes physical contact with a creature carrying the white ghost shivers must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw at the end of the encounter to avoid becoming infected.

At the start of its turn, if a creature can see the [MON], it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be overcome with a desire to kill and eat the ghost, and it must move as close to the [MON] as it can.

If the [MON] is knocked prone, each creature in its space or within [#] ft of it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

The [MON] is composed of 5 or more [MON]. If it is subjected to a spell, attack, or other effect that affects only one target, it takes any damage but ignores other effects. It can share its space with creatures or objects.

A creature that starts its turn in the [MON]'s space must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and have its hit point max reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken.

A creature that touches the [MON] or hits it with an attack causes spores to spew out of the [MON] in a [#] ft radius. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or contract [DISEASE].

On its next turn after a [MON] takes [#] or more damage from a single attack, it has advantage on attack rolls, it adds its proficiency bonus to damage rolls, and it can make one extra attack when it takes the attack action.

The [MON] babbles constantly. A living non-aberration creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] and can hear it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be confused (as the spell) [DURATION].

The [MON] ha sfour Flaming Seedpods. Used Flaming Seedpods may regrow each turn. If the [MON] starts its turn with less than four Flaming Seedpods roll a d6. On a roll of 5 or 6 it regrows 1d4 Flaming Seedpods to a max of 4.

When a creature starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON], it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be charmed [DURATION]. If the [MON] or one of its allies harms the charmed creature, this effect ends.

If the [MON]'s head is severed by a vorpal weapon or by other means, magical vines sprout from its neck and the head reattaches by the start of the [MON]'s next turn, preventing the [MON] from dying from the loss of its head.

Insects understand the [MON] and view it favorably. The [MON] can communicate simple ideas through words and gestures with insectoid beasts and has advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) made when interacting with such beasts.

When the [MON] dies, its infernal battery explodes. Creatures within [#] ft of the [MON] must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

A creature, object, or weapon that touches the [MON] is stuck to the [MON] [DURATION]. A creature can also use an action to make a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check, freeing itself or an object or creature within reach on a success.

Creatures inside a [MON]'s burning core take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of each of the [MON]'s turns. Escaping from a [MON]'s belly takes [#] ft of movement and a successful DC [SAVE_DC] Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.

When a creature dies within [#] ft of the [MON], its spirit can possess the [MON], incapacitating the [MON] [DURATION]. During this time, the spirit is affected by the speak with dead spell, speaking through the [MON]'s mouth.

During flood season, the [MON] is overcome with bloodthirsty malice. Its alignment shifts to chaotic evil, it gains the Blood Frenzy trait, and it loses the capacity to speak Common and its bonuses to History and Investigation.

If the [MON] is turned or affected by dispel evil and good or a similar effect, it transforms into an ordinary gnoll. Any damage it has taken carries over to its new form. If this damage exceeds its maximum hit points, it dies.

If the [MON] moves at least [#] ft straight toward a creature before hitting it with a melee attack, the attack is treated as though the [MON] scored a critical hit, but attack rolls against the [MON] have advantage [DURATION].

The [MON] can pinpoint, by scent, the location of creatures that aren't constructs or undead and that don't have all of their hit points within [#] ft of it and can sense general direction to such creatures within 1 mile of it.

The [MON] travels between shadows as if by means of a dimension door spell. This magical transport must begin and end in an area of dim light or darkness. The [MON] can jump up to a total of [#] ft per day in [#] ft increments.

When the [MON] dies, each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

Deprived of parental bonds, the [MON] despise those who nurture and heal others. The [MON] has advantage on attacks against a creature whose most recent action was to heal, restore, strengthen, or otherwise aid another creature.

If the [MON] is on fire, it takes 1 cold damage for every 5 ft it moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it. If the [MON] takes at least 100 points of cold damage within a [DURATION] period, its flame is doused.

The [MON]'s body is covered in horns, eyes, and fanged maws. Each creature of the [MON]'s choice that is within [#] ft of it and is aware of it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be frightened [DURATION].

If the [MON] is targeted by dispel magic, the caster must make a DC [SAVE_DC] spellcasting check. On a success, the [MON] is incapacitated [DURATION]. After [DURATION], it becomes animate again unless its body has been destroyed.

The [MON] can communicate with mosquitos as if they shared a language. The mosquitos alert the [MON] to the presence of intruders, and the [MON] has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice creatures within [#] ft of it.

When the [MON] dies, each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage plus [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. The [MON]s damaged by this trait don't Reproduce.

If the [MON] dies in the Nine Hells, it comes back to life with all its hit points in [DURATION] unless it is killed by a good-aligned creature with a bless spell cast on that creature or its remains are sprinkled with holy water.

The [MON] is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the [MON]'s intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

The [MON] must regularly inhale swamp gases to maintain its flight. If it can't breathe or isn't in swampy terrain, it loses its fly speed. Also when it uses Poisonous Breath it loses its fly speed until Poisonous Breath recharges.

If damage reduces the [MON] to 0 hit points, it must make a [ABILITY] saving throw with a DC equal to 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the [MON] drops to 1 hit point instead.

When a creature leaves the [MON]'s space, [#dX]-1 [MON]s remain grappled to them (escape DC [SAVE_DC]). Each [MON] inflicts [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of the creature's turns until it escapes from the grapples.

As long as at least one of its bones remains, a destroyed [MON] gathers a new body in [DURATION], regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. Its new body appears within [#] ft of the largest remaining bone from its body.

If defeated in combat, the [MON] returns in [DURATION]. It can be put to rest permanently only by finding and casting remove curse on its remains or by resolving the unfinished business that keeps it from journeying to the afterlife.

If the [MON] is knocked prone, it lands upside down and is incapacitated. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, flipping itself over and ending the incapacitated condition on a success.

The [MON] has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or escape effect that would reduce its speed. Also, nonmagical difficult terrain composed of natural rocks or cavernous terrain doesn't cost it extra movement.

The [MON] immediately recognizes any individual that is descended from its tribe. It has advantage on attack rolls against such creatures, and those creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the [MON]'s traits and attacks.

A creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] and that can see it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be unable to make more than one attack on its turn or use bonus actions or reactions [DURATION].

At the end of any turn in which the [MON] took at least [#] damage, roll a d8. On a 1, it loses an arm. On a 2, it loses a leg. In addition, [#dX] prone zombies in unoccupied spaces within [#] ft of the [MON], spilling from the wound.

Creatures that travel with the [MON] can't retrace their steps and become hopelessly lost after [DURATION] of travel. Creatures led astray by the [MON] have disadvantage on attempts to discern their location or to navigate [DURATION].

When damage is dealt to the [MON], the [MON] doesn't take the damage until its next turn. The [MON] must still make the appropriate saving throws, and it immediately suffers any extra effects of the damage; only the damage is delayed.

Any attacks directed at the [MON]'s mount targets the [MON] instead. Its mount gains the benefit of the rider's damage, and condition immunities, and if the [MON] passes a saving throw against an area effect, the mount takes no damage.

Fire damage melts some of the ice covering the [MON], unleashing its horrific stench. Each creature within [#] ft of the [MON] when it takes fire damage must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be poisoned [DURATION].

When bright light or a creature comes within [#] ft of the [MON], it emits a shriek that can be heard up to [#] ft away. The [MON] continues to shriek until the disturbance moves out of range and for 1d4 of the [MON]'s turns afterward.

A creature can target the [MON]'s eye with an attack. This attack is made with disadvantage. If the attack hits and deals at least [#] damage, creatures affected by the [MON]'s Charming and Mesmerizing Gaze are freed from those effects.

A creature slain by the [MON] can't be restored to life unless the [MON] is killed within [DURATION] of slaying the creature. After [DURATION], the soul becomes part of the [MON], and the creature can be restored only with a wish spell.

The [MON]'s particular madness grants it immunity to psychic effects. It can't be restored to sanity by any means short of a wish spell or similar magic. A [MON] brought to sanity gains 4 points of Wisdom and loses 6 points of Charisma.

The body of a creature that dies while grappled by a [MON] is completely absorbed into the [MON]'s mass. No portion of it remains to be used in raise dead, reincarnate, and comparable spells that require touching the dead person's body.

Within [DURATION] of being slain, the [MON] reforms within [#] ft of its creator. It doesn't reform if its creator is slain, or if the creator's mental disturbance is healed. The [MON] is immune to all damage dealt to it by its creator.

If the [MON] dies, its soul reforms on the Astral Plane. After [DURATION], it is reborn into the body of another elephantine creature on the Material Plane. Only killing every elephantine creature on the Material Plane will prevent this.

When the [MON] dies, it releases all the fear it consumed in its lifetime in a single, soul-rending wave. All creatures within [#] ft of it [OUTCOME]. A frightened creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of each of its turns.

If the [MON] is flying and dives at least [#] ft straight toward a target, it has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against that target before the end of its turn. If the attack hits, it deals an extra [#dX] damage to the target.

The first time the [MON] enters or moves through a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. When the [MON] moves through an object that isn't being worn or carried, the object takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

A creature that touches the [MON] or hits it with melee attack while within [#] ft of it takes [#dX] + [DMG_MOD] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and if the target is a humanoid it must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or contract [DISEASE].

The [MON] can fold its body into different sizes and shapes. The [MON] can adjust its size by one step in either direction, but can't be smaller than Tiny or larger than Medium size. Changes in size or shape don't affect the [MON]'s stats.

The [MON] is psychically bound to its creator and can communicate telepathically with its creator as long as neither is incapacitated. The [MON] and its creator don't have to be on the same plane of existence to communicate telepathically.

If a [MON] spends [DURATION] with a spellbook or a spell scroll, it can learn the magic of one 2nd level or lower spell, erasing and absorbing all the ink and magic used to inscribe the spell. The [MON] can then cast the spell once per day.

The [MON] can pinpoint the location of celestials, fiends, divine avatars, and deities within [#] ft of it and can sense the general direction to to such creatures within 1 mile of it. This sense extends into the Ethereal and Shadow Planes.

Whenever subjected to lightning it takes no damage, and instead regains hit points equal to lightning dealt. Its Supercharge then recharges. If it takes cold while supercharged it must roll a d6. On a 1 or 2 it loses the supercharged state.

feature.ability_name: Outcome of Starting Turn Near Monster
feature.desc: The [MON] constantly rattles its tail when in combat. Each creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] and that can hear it [OUTCOME]. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws is unaffected by the [MON]'s rattle [DURATION].

The [MON] makes its home in grime and muck and is covered in filth. A creature that touches the [MON] or hits it with a melee attack while within [#] ft of it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be poisoned [DURATION].

The [MON] projects a [#] ft aura of desiccating thirst. The first time a creature enters the aura on its turn, or when it starts its turn in the aura, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

A creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be restrained by the [MON]'s tentacles [DURATION]. On its turn, the [MON] can ignore or freely release a restrained creature.

If a creature communicates telepathically with the [MON], or uses a psychic attack against it, the [MON] can spread its disease to the creature. The creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be infected with [DISEASE].

Each hour the [MON] is fully immersed in water, it poisons up to 10 gallons of water. A creature that drinks this poisoned water must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be poisoned [DURATION].

When a creature within [#] ft of the [MON] regains hit points through any means other than resting, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and have disadvantage on its next death saving throw.

When the [MON] is hit by a spell or is in the area of a spell, it regains hit points equal to the spell's level. This trait doesn't counter the spell or negate its damage or effects. The [MON] regains the hit points after the spell is resolved.

If a [MON] is in the area of effect of a turn undead attempt, it gains temporary hit points. For each mordant puppet that would have been affected by the turning if it were a zombie, the [MON] gains [#] temporary hit points, to a maximum of [#].

Nonmagical weapons and objects with AC [#] or lower are immediately destroyed after coming into contact with the [MON]'s skin. Weapons that hit the [MON] deal their damage before being destroyed. This trait is suppressed if the [MON] is starving.

Each time it feeds in combat, it regains hit points equal to twice the level of the spell it ate and increases its Feed score by 1. The [MON] can't have a Feed score higher than 8, and its Feed score reduces by 1 each time it finishes a long rest.

Shape minor pseudopods into Medium or smaller objects. Creature that sees one can tell it is an imitation with DC [SAVE_DC] Wisdom (Insight) check. Creature with half its body in contact with object (ex: sitting on "chair") is subject to Adhesive.

The [MON] leaves a slime trail behind it as it moves. The slime creates difficult terrain, and any creature walking through it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or be knocked prone. The slime remains effective [DURATION].

When the [MON] successfully bites a creature, the creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the bite. If the [MON] remains attached to the target, the target can repeat this check at the start of each of its turns.

The [MON] can communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature inside the magical dome that surrounds its shell. Similarly, it can hear and understand any creature inside the dome, regardless of the language it speaks.

When the [MON] takes piercing or slashing damage, noxious vapors burst from its distended stomach. Each creature within [#] ft of it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and be poisoned [DURATION].

When the bodily fluid of an infected creature touches a humanoid or when an infected creature casts a spell (direct or indirect) on a humanoid, that humanoid must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be infected with arcane wasting.

The first time the [MON] enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and catches fire. Until someone uses an action to douse the fire, the creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of each of its turns.

The [MON] regains [#] hit points at the start of its turn for each creature within [#] ft of it that is incapacitated with laughter from its Tickle action. If a creature dies while suffering from the laughter, the [MON] gains [#] temporary hit points.

The first time the [MON] enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage, and catches fire; until a creature uses an action to douse the fire, the target takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of each of its turns.

A cloud of green mist with a diameter of 1 mile and height of [#] ft is centered on the [MON]. For each day a creature spends in the mist, it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or increase in age by 5 percent of its total life span.

The [MON] can spend [DURATION] crafting a poultice that lasts [DURATION]. When a creature uses an action to apply this poultice to a wound or skin of a creature, the target regains [#dX] hit points and is cured of any diseases or conditions affecting it.

When the [MON] is targeted by a ranged weapon attack or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 4 or 5, the attacker has disadvantage on the attack roll. On a 6, the attack misses the [MON], disappearing into the smoke surrounding it.

When the [MON] moves along the ground, it can choose to leave behind a trail of fire [#] ft wide and [#] ft tall, which lasts [DURATION]. A creature that begins its turn in the fire or enters it for the first time on a turn takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

Whenever the [MON] starts its turn inside magical darkness, it must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. Natural darkness is unpleasant to it, but not harmful.

A nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the [MON] corrodes after dealing damage, taking a permanent -1 penalty to damage rolls per hit. If this penalty reaches -5, the weapon is destroyed. Metal nonmagical ammunition is destroyed after dealing damage.

Even when the [MON] is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC [SAVE_DC] Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a [MON] that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the [MON]'s space while unaware of the [MON] is surprised by the [MON].

A creature in a space occupied by the [MON] has its speed reduced by half, and must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be blinded. Both effects end when the creature doesn't share a space with the [MON] at the end of the creature's turn.

The [MON] takes 1 point of Constitution damage for every hour it is exposed to sunlight, and it dies if its Constitution score reaches 0. Lost Constitution points are recovered at the rate of 1 per day spent underground or otherwise sheltered from the sun.

When the [MON] dies, its corpse transforms into crystal and becomes a Large object that can be attacked and destroyed (AC [#]; [#] hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). It can no longer be affected by spells and effects that target creatures.

When the [MON] is reduced to half its maximum hit points or fewer, unstable arcane energy begins to pour from its metal body. A creature that touches the unstable [MON] or hits it with a melee attack while within [#] ft of it takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

A [MON] who begins its turn within [#] ft of burning incense must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls [DURATION]. The [MON] can't voluntarily move toward the incense. Burning old shoes has the same effect.

A single [MON]'s rigid movements appear silly, but, when gathered in numbers, they become an inhuman terror. When the [MON] makes a Charisma (Intimidation) check, it gains a bonus on that check equal to the number of other [MON]s the target can see or hear.

If a creature has three or more [MON] attached to it from a bite attack at the end of its turn, the creature must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or its Constitution score is reduced by [#dX] as the [MON]s feast upon the creature's flesh.

The [MON] is never voluntarily without its partner. No magical effect or power can cause the [MON] to act against its mate, and no charm or domination effect can cause it to leave their side or to change their feelings of love and loyalty toward each other.

At the start of the [MON]'s turn during combat, one corpse falls from the [MON] onto the ground and immediately rises as a zombie under its control. Up to 10 such zombies can be active at one time. Zombies take their turns immediately after the [MON]'s turn.

A creature within [#] ft of the [MON] who meets the [MON]'s gaze must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be blinded. If a creature's saving throw is successful or if the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this effect [DURATION].

Any time the [MON] is targeted by a ranged spell attack roll, roll a d6. On a 5, the [MON] is unaffected. On a 6, the [MON] is unaffected and the spell is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the [MON], turning the caster into the target.

During the first turn of combat, the [MON] has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't acted. Any hit the [MON] scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit, and every creature that can see the [MON]'s attack is rattled [DURATION].

The [MON] emits a light fog within [#] ft of itself. The mist moves with the [MON], lightly obscuring the area around it. If dispersed by a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour), the mist reappears at the start of the [MON]'s next turn.

When exposed central stalk can be attacked and destroyed (AC [#]; [#] hit points; vulnerability to acid cold and fire). If central stalk is destroyed [MON] has disadvantage on attacks and can't use Expose Stalk until it regrows one at the end of next long rest.

When the [MON] is destroyed, its core explodes, projecting superheated steam and shrapnel. Each creature within [#] ft of it must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

The [MON] and its jelly are wholly reliant on each other. If the [MON]'s jelly is somehow separated from its master, the jelly dies within [DURATION]. If the [MON] is separated from its jelly, it loses its blindsight, Acid Glob action, and Jelly Symbiosis trait.

If completely immersed in water, a [MON]'s movement halves each round until it stops moving completely, becoming incapacitated, and contact with it no longer causes damage. As soon as any portion of it is exposed to the air again, it resumes moving at full speed.

The [MON] and any creatures within a [#] ft radius are immune to the effects of natural, environmental cold. If it is invited into a home or building, the [MON] can expand this warming presence to all of its inhabitants, no matter how close they are to the [MON].

Each creature other than a [MON] within [#] ft of the [MON] when it takes damage must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be blinded [DURATION]. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the Tearful Stench of all [MON]s [DURATION].

When the [MON]'s conjurer orders it to find a creature, it can do so unerringly, despite the distance or intervening obstacles, provided the target is on the same plane of existence. The conjurer must have seen the desired target and must speak the target's name.

Creatures restrained by its Encage automatically stabilize at 0 hit points and take no further damage from Encage. If creature damaged from another source while restrained suffers death save failure as normal but immediately stabilizes if not its final death save.

If the [MON] moves at least [#] ft straight toward a creature before hitting it with a melee attack, the target takes an extra [#dX] damage and must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be pushed up to [#] ft away from the [MON] and knocked prone.

A creature that enters or starts its turn inside the [MON]'s whirlwind takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. A creature can take this damage just once per round. In addition, ranged missile weapon attacks against the [MON] have disadvantage because of the high-speed wind.

Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saves. Considers every creature hostile and doesn't benefit from Help action or similar spells/effects that involve help to/from allies. Doesn't stop spellcaster from restoring hit points to it or curing the [MON] with magic.

Whenever the [MON] demon is subjected to fire or necrotic damage, it takes no damage, and instead is unaffected by spells and other magical effects that would impede its movement. This trait works like the freedom of movement spell, except it only lasts [DURATION].

Any creature hostile to the [MON] that starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or have disadvantage on all attack rolls [DURATION]. Creatures with Intelligence 3 or lower automatically fail the saving throw.

If a creature starts its turn within [#] ft of a [MON], it is overwhelmed by a hunger that dissolves fat and atrophies muscle. It must make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw, taking [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

The [MON] grows more powerful when it has charmed allies. For each charmed ally within [#] ft of it, the [MON] gains [#] temporary hit points at the start of its turn, its AC increases by 1, and it deals an extra [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage when it hits with any attack.

The [MON] is bound to a region of swamp within 1 mile of its body. If the [MON] leaves region loses its Soul Drain action until it returns to the region. If it remains outside region automatically teleports back to its corpse after [DURATION] regardless of distance.

The [MON] produces a faint, nauseating gas. Any creature that starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. The area within [#] ft of the [MON] is lightly obscured by the thin gas.

The [MON]'s saliva can be bottled, distilled, and used in 1-ounce doses. An afflicted lycanthrope that drinks this concoction is instantly cured of lycanthropy, requiring no saving throw. This draught can't cure a natural-born lycanthrope of the curse of lycanthropy.

When the [MON] is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a spray of silver pieces. Each hostile creature within [#] ft of the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. The silver pieces disappear after [DURATION].

A small door on the chest of the [MON] opens into an extra-dimensional bookcase. This bookcase functions exactly as a bag of holding except that it can store only written materials such as books, scrolls, tomes, parchment, folders, notebooks, spellbooks, and the like.

If the [MON] is in an area targeted by a spell that enhances plants in that area, such as the entangle, plant growth, and spike growth spells, the [MON] absorbs the spell, ending it, and gains 10 temporary hit points for each level of the spell it absorbed [DURATION].

The [MON]'s sap seeps into the soil, promoting lush vegetation. At any given time, 3d6 beneficial fruits (fruit, nuts, figs, dates) can be found within [#] ft of the [MON]. These have the same effect as berries from a goodberry spell, but they retain their potency for one week after being picked or after the [MON] is killed.

Unattended magic items in the [MON]'s space at the end of the [MON]'s turn have their effects suppressed [DURATION]; charged items in the [MON]'s space lose 1d6 charges at the start of each of the [MON]'s turns; items with limited uses per day lose one daily use; and single-use items such as potions or scrolls are destroyed.

Difficult terrain composed of tombstones grave dirt corpses or other objects or features common to graveyards and necropolises doesn't cost it extra move and it can move through graveyard objects and structures (ex: sarcophagus mausoleum) as if difficult terrain. It takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage if it ends turn inside object.

The [MON] has an appetite for gold, silver, and jewels and consumes them whenever possible. If the [MON] attempts to eat a magical coin, gemstone, or piece of jewelry, the object has a 25 percent chance of breaking, dispelling its magic and rendering it useless. If the object doesn't break, the [MON] gives up trying to eat it.

When the [MON] scores a critical hit or starts its turn with a foe grappled, it can dissolve one leather, metal, or wood item of its choosing in the possession of the target creature. A mundane item is destroyed automatically; a magical item is destroyed if its owner fails to succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw.

The [MON]'s limbs can be attacked (AC [#]; [#] hit points; vulnerability to lightning damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a limb deals no damage to the [MON], which can create a replacement on its next turn. A limb can also be destroyed if a creature succeeds on a DC [SAVE_DC] Strength check as an action.

When a creature starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] and can see the [MON]'s eyes, it can choose to shut its eyes [DURATION] unless it is surprised or incapacitated. Otherwise, the [MON] uses its petrifying gaze on the creature. If the [MON] sees its own reflection and doesn't shut its eyes, it is subject to its own gaze.

A creature that touches the [MON] while wearing metal or hits it with a melee attack with a metal weapon takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and triggers a lightning storm. All creatures within [#] ft of the [MON] that are holding or wearing metal must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

A creature can use its action to formally challenge the [MON] to a duel of rhymes. If no creature attacks the [MON] [DURATION], it uses its action to recite a rhyme. The challenger must respond to the rhyme and succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] Charisma (Performance) check. On a success, the [MON] is treated as if it is turned [DURATION].

An [MON] is inherently fearful of fire. If presented forcefully with fire or if it is dealt fire the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be frightened [DURATION]. Once it has been frightened by a specific source of fire (such as a torch) the [MON] can't be frightened by that same source again [DURATION].

Any object that touches or hits the [MON] vaporizes. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw to prevent the object from being vaporized. If the object is magical, the creature has advantage on the saving throw. The [MON] can choose to not vaporize an object.

The [MON] can use [#] ft of its movement to step from its position to the point of a steeple, mast, or other spire-like feature that is in view within [#] ft of it. The [MON] has advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and Dexterity saving throws while it is standing on a steeple or any similar narrow, steep structure or feature.

When the [MON] hits with an attack, he can choose to banish the target to the Eleven Hells. The target vanishes from its current location and is incapacitated until its return. At the end of the [MON]'s next turn, the target returns to the spot it previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space and takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage.

A creature that has received assistance, such as food or healing, from the [MON] must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be affected by the geas spell [DURATION]. While under the geas, the affected creature must assist nonhostile creatures suffering from injury or exhaustion by alleviating the injury or exhaustion.

Lycanthropes are repelled by the wolfsbane flower. A lycanthrope in hybrid or beast form is poisoned while within [#] ft of a living or dried wolfsbane flower that it can smell. If wolfsbane is applied to a weapon or ammunition, lycanthropes are damaged by the weapon as if it were silver. An application of wolfsbane lasts [DURATION].

If a creature uses an action to point out an ordered group of objects to the [MON], the [MON] is compelled to count the entire group. [DURATION], the [MON] has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks and it can't take reactions. Once it has counted a given group of objects, it can't be compelled to count those objects ever again.

Once on its turn, the [MON] can use [#] ft of its movement to step into a body of water within reach and emerge from a second body of water within [#] ft of the first, appearing in an unoccupied space within [#] ft of it. If the [MON] is in a Huge or larger body of water, it can teleport to another location within the same body of water.

The [MON] affects chance and probability around it. While this aura is active, creatures within [#] ft of the [MON] can't have advantage or disadvantage on any ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. This aura affects the [MON]. At the start of each of its turns, the [MON] can choose whether this aura is active (no action required).

The [MON] emits a constant, demoralizing cackle. When a creature that isn't an undead or a construct starts its turn within [#] ft of the [MON] and can hear the [MON], it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or feel demoralized by the [MON]'s cackling. A demoralized creature has disadvantage on attack rolls [DURATION].

The [MON] can be targeted by the calm emotions spell. If it fails the saving throw, it takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage at the start of each of its turns, as long as the spellcaster maintains concentration on the spell. If it succeeds on the saving throw, it takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage but isn't further affected by that casting of the spell.

The [MON] produces pitcher-shaped magical fruit. When creature picks fruit is subjected to Wondrous Cornucopia. Fruit withers [DURATION] after picking losing all magic. If creature expends spell slot of 3rd+ level or volunteers 2 Hit Dice of life (rolling them losing hit points equal to result) while picking choose effect instead of random.

At the start of its next turn, it returns to the Material Plane in an unoccupied space of its choice that it can see within [#] ft of the space where it vanished. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, it appears in the nearest unoccupied space. While in the Plane of Shadow, the [MON] can see and hear [#] ft into the Material.

Any food or water that comes into contact with the [MON] immediately decays and becomes inedible or undrinkable. If a creature consumes such food or drink it must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or take [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage and be poisoned [DURATION]. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is poisoned [DURATION].

If the [MON] doesn't have 4 luck points at sunset, it gains 2 luck points. It can't have more than 4 luck points at a time. In addition, if the [MON] rolls a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw while it has at least 1 luck point, it can reroll the die and must use the new roll. This trait doesn't expend luck points.

A creature or a metal object that touches the [MON] takes [#dX] [DMG_TYPE] damage. A nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the black pudding corrodes after dealing damage, taking a permanent -1 penalty to damage rolls per hit. If this penalty reaches -5, the weapon is destroyed. Metal nonmagical ammunition is destroyed after dealing damage.

If the [MON] engages at least one creature in conversation for at least [DURATION], it can perform a prophetic display, reading cards, throwing bones, speaking to a crystal ball, or similar. Each creature that can see or hear the prophetic display must succeed on a DC [SAVE_DC] [ABILITY] saving throw or be cursed and believe it will soon die.

The [MON] can sense healing spells, effects, and potions within [#] ft of it.
